- from those... 与 different 构成 be different from 搭配，因定语从句较长而被分隔，阅读时需还原 different from those 的关联。

## 翻译

例如，当美国人使用“朋友”这个词时，这个词的文化内涵可能与它在访客的语言和文化中的含义大不相同。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The phrase “substance abuse” is often used instead of “drug abuse” to
entries.text:
## 原句

The phrase “substance abuse” is often used instead of “drug abuse” to make clear that substances such as alcohol and tobacco can be just as harmfully misused as heroin and cocaine.

**标签**：被动语态 / 名词性从句 / 比较结构

## 生词

- substance/ˈsʌbstəns/n.物质；实质
- abuse/əˈbjuːs/n.滥用；虐待
- misuse/ˌmɪsˈjuːz/vt.误用；滥用
- tobacco/təˈbækoʊ/n.烟草，烟叶
- heroin/ˈherɔɪn/n.海洛因
- cocaine/koʊˈkeɪn/n.可卡因

## 主干

主干为「The phrase（主）+ is used（谓，被动）」，不定式 to make clear that... 作目的状语。

## 解析

- 本句主干：The phrase “substance abuse” is often used instead of “drug abuse”，为被动语态，instead of 表明用前者替换后者。
- to make clear that... 为不定式作目的状语；make clear 后接 that 从句作真正的宾语，形容词 clear 后置作宾语补足语，属于宾语后置结构。
- that substances...can be misused 为 that 引导的宾语从句；such as alcohol and tobacco 为举例成分，修饰从句主语 substances。
- just as harmfully misused as heroin and cocaine 为 as...as 同级比较结构，说明酒精、烟草被滥用的危害程度与海洛因、可卡因相当。

## 翻译

“物质滥用”这一说法常被用来代替“药物滥用”，为的是明确表明：酒精和烟草等物质与海洛因和可卡因一样，都可能被有害地滥用。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: We live in a society in which the medicinal and social use of substanc
entries.text:
## 原句

We live in a society in which the medicinal and social use of substances (drugs) is pervasive: an aspirin to quiet a headache, some wine to be sociable, coffee to get going in the morning, a cigarette for the nerves.

**标签**：定语从句 / 并列结构 / 非谓语动词

## 生词

- medicinal/məˈdɪsɪnl/adj.药用的；有疗效的
- pervasive/pərˈveɪsɪv/adj.普遍的；无处不在的
- sociable/ˈsoʊʃəbl/adj.好交际的；善于社交的
- aspirin/ˈæsprɪn/n.阿司匹林
- quiet/ˈkwaɪət/vt.（僻）平息；减轻（疼痛、不安）
- substance/ˈsʌbstəns/n.物质
- nerve/nɜːrv/n.神经；勇气

## 主干

主干为「We（主）+ live in（谓）+ a society（宾）」，in which 引导定语从句修饰 society，冒号后为四个并列名词短语举例。

## 解析

- 本句主干：We live in a society，其后 in which the medicinal and social use of substances (drugs) is pervasive 为 in which 引导的定语从句，修饰 society。
- 定语从句内主干为 the use is pervasive；medicinal and social 为并列形容词作前置定语，of substances (drugs) 为介词短语作后置定语，括号内 drugs 是 substances 的同位语。
- 冒号后为四个并列名词短语 an aspirin...、some wine...、coffee...、a cigarette...，对 pervasive 进行具体举例说明。
- 各短语中 to quiet a headache、to be sociable、to get going in the morning 为不定式作目的状语，for the nerves 为介词短语表用途，意为“稳定情绪”。

## 翻译

我们生活在这样一个社会里：物质（药物）在医疗和社交方面的使用十分普遍——服一片阿司匹林缓解头痛，喝点酒帮助交际，清晨喝咖啡提神，抽支烟稳定情绪。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Dependence is marked first by an increased tolerance, with more and mo
entries.text:
## 原句

Dependence is marked first by an increased tolerance, with more and more of the substance required to produce the desired effect, and then by the appearance of unpleasant withdrawal symptoms when the substance is discontinued.

**标签**：被动语态 / 独立主格 / 状语从句

## 生词

- dependence/dɪˈpendəns/n.依赖（指对药物的依赖性）
- tolerance/ˈtɑːlərəns/n.（僻）耐受性（药量）；容忍
- withdrawal/wɪðˈdrɔːəl/n.（僻）戒断，脱瘾；撤退；取款
- symptom/ˈsɪmptəm/n.症状；征兆
- appearance/əˈpɪrəns/n.出现；外表
- discontinue/ˌdɪskənˈtɪnjuː/vt.停止；中断

## 主干

主干为「Dependence（主）+ is marked（谓，被动）+ first by... and then by...（两个并列介词短语作状语）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：Dependence is marked first by an increased tolerance and then by the appearance of unpleasant withdrawal symptoms，两个 by 介词短语由 first...and then... 并列，说明依赖的两个标志。
- with more and more of the substance required to produce the desired effect 为 with 复合结构（独立主格）作伴随状语，其中 required 为过去分词作后置定语，修饰 substance。
- when the substance is discontinued 为 when 引导的时间状语从句，修饰第二个 by 短语中的 the appearance，说明戒断症状出现的前提，从句本身也是被动语态。

## 翻译

药物依赖首先表现为耐药性增强，即需要越来越多的药物才能产生预期的效果；其次表现为一旦停止用药，就会出现令人难受的戒断症状。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Drugs (substances) that affect the central nervous system and alter pe
entries.text:
## 原句

Drugs (substances) that affect the central nervous system and alter perception, mood, and behavior are known as psychoactive substances.

**标签**：定语从句 / 被动语态 / 并列结构

## 生词

- affect/əˈfekt/vt.影响；感动
- alter/ˈɔːltər/vt.改变，更改
- perception/pərˈsepʃn/n.感知，知觉；看法
- behavior/bɪˈheɪvjər/n.行为，举止
- psychoactive/ˌsaɪkoʊˈæktɪv/adj.作用于精神的，影响心理状态的

## 主干

主干为「Drugs (substances)（主）+ are known as（谓，被动）+ psychoactive substances（主语补足语）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：Drugs (substances) are known as psychoactive substances，为被动语态，括号内 substances 是 drugs 的同位解释语。
- that affect... and alter... 为 that 引导的定语从句，修饰先行词 drugs (substances)；从句内 affect 与 alter 为并列谓语。
- perception, mood, and behavior 为三个并列名词，共同作 alter 的宾语，列举药物改变的三类对象。
- 定语从句较长，把主语与谓语 are known 分隔开来，阅读时应先剥离从句再抓主干。

## 翻译

影响中枢神经系统并改变感知、情绪和行为的药物（物质）被称为精神活性物质。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The test of any democratic society lies not in how well it can control
entries.text:
## 原句

The test of any democratic society lies not in how well it can control expression but in whether it gives freedom of thought and expression the widest possible latitude, however disputable or irritating the results may sometimes be.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 并列结构 / 状语从句

## 生词

- democratic/ˌdeməˈkrætɪk/adj.民主的
- latitude/ˈlætɪtuːd/n.（僻）自由度，言论行动的自由范围；纬度
- expression/ɪkˈspreʃn/n.表达，言论；表情
- disputable/dɪˈspjuːtəbl/adj.有争议的，可争辩的
- irritating/ˈɪrɪteɪtɪŋ/adj.令人恼火的，使人不快的

## 主干

主干为「The test（主）+ lies（谓）+ not in... but in...（并列介词短语作状语）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：The test of any democratic society lies not in... but in...，lie in 意为“在于”，not...but... 并列两个 in 介词短语，构成取舍对照。
- how well it can control expression 为 how 引导的宾语从句，作第一个介词 in 的宾语，说明“不在于”的内容。
- whether it gives freedom of thought and expression the widest possible latitude 为 whether 引导的宾语从句，作第二个 in 的宾语；gives 为双宾动词，freedom... 为间接宾语，the widest possible latitude 为直接宾语。
- however disputable or irritating the results may sometimes be 为 however 引导的让步状语从句，表语 disputable or irritating 提前，修饰整个主句。

## 翻译

检验任何一个民主社会的标准，不在于它能将言论控制得多么好，而在于它是否给予思想自由和言论自由以最大可能的宽容，无论由此产生的结果有时会多么有争议、多么令人恼火。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Though some of us have known for many, many years that the freedoms un
entries.text:
## 原句

Though some of us have known for many, many years that the freedoms under the First Amendment are not totally unlimited, I think it is perhaps the case that some people associated with the company have only recently come to realize this.

**标签**：状语从句 / 名词性从句 / 同位语从句

## 生词

- amendment/əˈmendmənt/n.修正案；修改，修订
- associate/əˈsoʊʃieɪt/vt.使联系；be associated with 与……有关联
- case/keɪs/n.情况；实例；it is the case that... 意为“事实是……”
- company/ˈkʌmpəni/n.公司；陪伴

## 主干

主干为「I（主）+ think（谓）+ it is perhaps the case that...（宾语从句）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：I think (that) it is perhaps the case that...，think 后为省略引导词 that 的宾语从句，表达说话人的推测。
- Though some of us have known... 为 though 引导的让步状语从句；其中 that the freedoms under the First Amendment are not totally unlimited 为 that 引导的宾语从句，作 have known 的宾语，被时间状语 for many, many years 与谓语分隔。
- it is perhaps the case that... 中，that some people...have come to realize this 为 that 引导的同位语从句，说明 case 的具体内容。
- associated with the company 为过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 some people，意为“与该公司有关系的”。

## 翻译

尽管我们当中有些人多年来早已知道，第一修正案所规定的自由并非毫无限制，但我想，与该公司有关的一些人或许只是最近才意识到这一点。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Much of the language used to describe monetary policy, such as “steeri
entries.text:
## 原句

Much of the language used to describe monetary policy, such as “steering the economy to a soft landing” or “a touch on the brakes”, makes it sound like a precise science.

**标签**：非谓语动词 / 插入语 / 分隔结构

## 生词

- monetary/ˈmʌnɪteri/adj.货币的；金融的
- steer/stɪr/vt.驾驶；引导，操控
- landing/ˈlændɪŋ/n.着陆；soft landing（经济）软着陆
- touch/tʌtʃ/n.（僻）轻触，轻按；触碰
- brake/breɪk/n.刹车，制动器
- precise/prɪˈsaɪs/adj.精确的，准确的

## 主干

主干为「Much of the language（主）+ makes（谓）+ it（宾）+ sound like a precise science（宾补）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：Much of the language...makes it sound like a precise science，make 接宾语 it，再接省略 to 的不定式 sound like... 作宾语补足语。
- used to describe monetary policy 为过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 the language，说明这些语言的用途。
- such as “steering the economy to a soft landing” or “a touch on the brakes” 为插入语，由 or 并列两个例子，具体展示 the language，并将主语与谓语 makes 分隔。
- it 指代 monetary policy；steering 为动名词短语，a touch on the brakes 为名词短语，均为所引语言的实例。

## 翻译

许多用来描述货币政策的语言，比如“引导经济软着陆”或“轻踩刹车”，使货币政策听起来像一门精确的科学。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Perhaps it is humankind’s long suffering at the mercy of flood and dro
entries.text:
## 原句

Perhaps it is humankind’s long suffering at the mercy of flood and drought that makes the idea of forcing the waters to do our bidding so fascinating.

**标签**：强调句 / 非谓语动词

## 生词

- drought/draʊt/n.旱灾；干旱
- mercy/ˈmɜːrsi/n.仁慈；宽恕（at the mercy of 受……摆布）
- humankind/ˌhjuːmənˈkaɪnd/n.人类
- bid/bɪd/v.出价；投标；（do one's bidding）听候……吩咐（僻）
- water/ˈwɔːtər/n.水；（僻）水域；水流
- fascinating/ˈfæsɪneɪtɪŋ/adj.极有吸引力的；迷人的

## 主干

本句为 it is...that... 强调句，强调主语；还原后主干为「humankind’s long suffering（主）+ makes（谓）+ the idea（宾）+ fascinating（宾补）」。

## 解析

- 本句为强调句型 it is...that...，被强调的部分是主语 humankind’s long suffering at the mercy of flood and drought；去掉强调框架后句子为 Perhaps humankind’s long suffering... makes the idea... so fascinating。
- at the mercy of flood and drought 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 suffering，意为“任凭洪水和干旱摆布的”。
- of forcing the waters to do our bidding 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 the idea；forcing 为动名词，带宾语 the waters 和宾语补足语 to do our bidding。
- so fascinating 为宾语补足语，与 makes 构成 make+宾语+形容词补语结构，即“使这一想法如此令人着迷”。

## 翻译

或许正是人类长期任凭洪水和干旱摆布的苦难，使得“迫使水流听从人类调遣”这一想法显得如此令人神往。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The Aswan Dam, for example, stopped the Nile flooding but deprived Egy
entries.text:
## 原句

The Aswan Dam, for example, stopped the Nile flooding but deprived Egypt of the fertile silt that floods left—all in return for a giant reservoir of disease which is now so full of silt that it barely generates electricity.

**标签**：并列结构 / 定语从句 / 状语从句

## 生词

- deprive/dɪˈpraɪv/vt.剥夺；使丧失（deprive...of...）
- fertile/ˈfɜːrtl/adj.肥沃的；富饶的
- silt/sɪlt/n.淤泥；泥沙
- reservoir/ˈrezərvwɑːr/n.水库；蓄水池；（知识、资源的）储藏
- generate/ˈdʒenəreɪt/vt.产生；引起；发电
- barely/ˈberli/adv.几乎不；仅仅

## 主干

主干为「The Aswan Dam（主）+ stopped...but deprived（并列谓）+ the Nile flooding / Egypt of the fertile silt（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 The Aswan Dam stopped the Nile flooding but deprived Egypt of the fertile silt，but 连接两个并列谓语；deprive...of... 意为“使……失去……”；for example 为插入语。
- that floods left 为定语从句，引导词 that，修饰先行词 silt，说明是洪水过去冲积留下的肥沃淤泥。
- 破折号后的 all in return for a giant reservoir of disease 为总结性补充成分，概括前面建坝的种种做法换来的只是一个“病害之库”。
- which is now so full of silt that it barely generates electricity 为定语从句，修饰 reservoir，其中内嵌 so...that... 引导的结果状语从句。

## 翻译

例如，阿斯旺大坝拦住了尼罗河的洪水，却也使埃及失去了洪水留下的肥沃淤泥——而这一切换来的只是一座滋生病害的巨型水库，如今它淤泥满积，几乎发不出电来。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The trouble is that part of the recent acceleration is due to the usua
entries.text:
## 原句

The trouble is that part of the recent acceleration is due to the usual rebound that occurs at this point in a business cycle, and so is not conclusive evidence of a revival in the underlying trend.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 定语从句 / 并列结构

## 生词

- acceleration/əkˌseləˈreɪʃn/n.加速；增速
- rebound/ˈriːbaʊnd/n.回弹；反弹；回升
- conclusive/kənˈkluːsɪv/adj.决定性的；确凿的
- revival/rɪˈvaɪvl/n.复苏；复兴
- underlying/ˌʌndərˈlaɪnɪŋ/adj.根本的；潜在的

## 主干

主干为「The trouble（主）+ is（系）+ that 引导的表语从句（表）」，从句内 and 连接 is due to 与 is not... 两个并列谓语。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 The trouble is that...，that 引导表语从句，说明 trouble 的具体内容。
- 表语从句内部主干为 part of the recent acceleration is due to the usual rebound... and so is not conclusive evidence...，and 连接两个并列谓语，so 承接上文表示“因此”。
- that occurs at this point in a business cycle 为定语从句，引导词 that，修饰先行词 rebound，说明这种反弹是商业周期在此阶段的惯常现象。
- of a revival in the underlying trend 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 evidence，意为“潜在趋势复苏的证据”。

## 翻译

问题在于，近期增长的加速有一部分只是源于商业周期在此阶段通常出现的反弹，因此并不能作为根本趋势正在复苏的确凿证据。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: New ways of organizing the workplace—all that re-engineering and downs
entries.text:
## 原句

New ways of organizing the workplace—all that re-engineering and downsizing —are only one contribution to the overall productivity of an economy, which is driven by many other factors such as joint investment in equipment and machinery, new technology, and investment in education and training.

**标签**：插入语 / 定语从句 / 被动语态

## 生词

- re-engineer/ˌriːˈendʒɪnɪr/vt.重新设计；对（企业流程）进行再造
- downsize/ˈdaʊnsaɪz/vt.裁减（人员）；缩小（规模）
- overall/ˌoʊvərˈɔːl/adj.总体的；全面的
- productivity/ˌprɑːdʌkˈtɪvəti/n.生产率；生产效率
- joint/dʒɔɪnt/adj.联合的；共同的
- machinery/məˈʃiːnəri/n.机器；机械（总称）
- drive/draɪv/vt.驱动；推动；驱使

## 主干

主干为「New ways（主）+ are（系）+ one contribution（表）」，破折号之间为插入语，句末 which 引导非限定性定语从句。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 New ways of organizing the workplace are only one contribution to the overall productivity of an economy；organizing 为动名词作介词 of 的宾语。
- 破折号之间 all that re-engineering and downsizing 为插入语，对 New ways 作补充解释；此处 that 是指示限定词（“那些”），并非从句引导词。
- which is driven by many other factors... 为非限定性定语从句，修饰先行词 productivity，从句为被动语态。
- such as 后接 joint investment..., new technology, and investment... 三个并列成分，具体列举驱动生产率的其他因素。

## 翻译

新的工作场所组织方式——即所有那些企业流程再造和裁员——只是促进一个经济体整体生产率的因素之一，生产率还受到许多其他因素的推动，例如在设备和机械上的联合投资、新技术以及对教育和培训的投资。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: A survey of news stories in 1996 reveals that the anti-science tag has
entries.text:
## 原句

A survey of news stories in 1996 reveals that the anti-science tag has been attached to many other groups as well, from authorities who advocated the elimination of the last remaining stocks of smallpox virus to Republicans who advocated decreased funding for basic research.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 定语从句 / 被动语态

## 生词

- survey/ˈsɜːrveɪ/n.调查；概览
- reveal/rɪˈviːl/vt.显示；揭露
- tag/tæɡ/n.标签；称号
- advocate/ˈædvəkeɪt/vt.提倡；主张
- elimination/ɪˌlɪmɪˈneɪʃn/n.消灭；消除
- stock/stɑːk/n.库存；（僻）储备量
- smallpox/ˈsmɔːlpɑːks/n.天花
- attach/əˈtætʃ/vt.贴上；附加（be attached to 被加于）

## 主干

主干为「A survey（主）+ reveals（谓）+ that 引导的宾语从句（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 A survey of news stories in 1996 reveals that...，that 引导宾语从句，作 reveals 的宾语。
- 宾语从句主干为 the anti-science tag has been attached to many other groups as well，为现在完成时的被动语态。
- from authorities who... to Republicans who... 为介词短语，对 many other groups 作范围举例；两个 who 引导的定语从句分别修饰 authorities 和 Republicans。
- of the last remaining stocks of smallpox virus 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 elimination；decreased 为过去分词作定语，修饰 funding。

## 翻译

一项针对 1996 年新闻报道的调查显示，“反科学”的标签还被贴到了许多其他团体身上：从主张销毁最后一批天花病毒储备的权威机构，到主张削减基础研究经费的共和党人。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The true enemies of science, argues Paul Ehrlich of Stanford Universit
entries.text:
## 原句

The true enemies of science, argues Paul Ehrlich of Stanford University, a pioneer of environmental studies, are those who question the evidence supporting global warming, the depletion of the ozone layer and other consequences of industrial growth.

**标签**：插入语 / 倒装 / 定语从句

## 生词

- argue/ˈɑːrɡjuː/vt.主张；论证；认为
- pioneer/ˌpaɪəˈnɪr/n.先驱；开拓者
- question/ˈkwestʃən/vt.质疑；怀疑（僻）
- ozone/ˈoʊzoʊn/n.臭氧
- depletion/dɪˈpliːʃn/n.消耗；耗竭

## 主干

主干为「The true enemies of science（主）+ are（系）+ those（表）」，中间插入主谓倒装的引述语 argues Paul Ehrlich。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 The true enemies of science are those who...；argues Paul Ehrlich of Stanford University 为插入的引述语，采用谓语提前的主谓倒装，相当于 Paul Ehrlich of Stanford University argues。
- a pioneer of environmental studies 为同位语，补充说明 Paul Ehrlich 的身份。
- who question the evidence... 为定语从句，引导词 who，修饰先行词 those，指“质疑证据的那些人”。
- supporting global warming... 为现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰 evidence；global warming, the depletion of the ozone layer and other consequences 为三个并列名词短语，共同作 supporting 的宾语。

## 翻译

斯坦福大学环境研究先驱保罗·埃利希认为，科学的真正敌人是那些质疑相关证据的人——这些证据涉及全球变暖、臭氧层损耗以及工业增长带来的其他后果。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Scattered around the globe are more than 100 small regions of isolated
entries.text:
## 原句

Scattered around the globe are more than 100 small regions of isolated volcanic activity known to geologists as hot spots.

**标签**：倒装 / 被动语态

## 生词

- scatter/ˈskætər/vt.使散布；使分散
- isolated/ˈaɪsəleɪtɪd/adj.孤立的；分离的
- volcanic/vɑːlˈkænɪk/adj.火山的
- geologist/dʒiˈɑːlədʒɪst/n.地质学家
- hot spot/ˈhɑːt spɑːt/n.热点（地质学上孤立的火山活动区）

## 主干

本句为倒装句，还原后主干为「more than 100 small regions（主）+ are scattered（被动谓语）+ around the globe（地点状语）」。

## 解析

- 本句为完全倒装：过去分词短语 Scattered around the globe 连同系动词 are 提到主语之前，真正的主语是 more than 100 small regions of isolated volcanic activity，正常语序为 More than 100 small regions... are scattered around the globe。
- of isolated volcanic activity 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 regions，说明这些区域的性质。
- known to geologists as hot spots 为过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 regions，其中 know...as... 结构表示“被地质学家称为热点”。

## 翻译

全球各地散布着 100 多个孤立的火山活动小区域，地质学家称其为“热点”。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The complementary coastlines and certain geological features that seem
entries.text:
## 原句

The complementary coastlines and certain geological features that seem to span the ocean are reminders of where the two continents were once joined.

**标签**：定语从句 / 名词性从句

## 生词

- complementary/ˌkɑːmplɪˈmentri/adj.互补的；相互配齐的
- geological/ˌdʒiːəˈlɑːdʒɪkl/adj.地质的
- span/spæn/vt.横跨；跨越；n. 跨度
- reminder/rɪˈmaɪndər/n.提醒物；令人想起……的事物
- continent/ˈkɑːntɪnənt/n.大陆；洲
- feature/ˈfiːtʃər/n.特征；（僻）地貌

## 主干

主干为「The complementary coastlines and certain geological features（并列主语）+ are（系）+ reminders（表）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 The complementary coastlines and certain geological features are reminders of...，and 连接两个并列主语。
- that seem to span the ocean 为定语从句，引导词 that，修饰先行词 features，说明这些地质特征似乎横跨大洋。
- of where the two continents were once joined 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 reminders；其中 where 引导宾语从句作介词 of 的宾语，表示“两块大陆曾经相连之处”。

## 翻译

那些相互吻合的海岸线以及似乎横跨大洋的某些地质特征，都令人想起这两块大陆曾经相连的所在。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: It is not possible to determine whether both continents are moving in
entries.text:
## 原句

It is not possible to determine whether both continents are moving in opposite directions or whether one continent is stationary and the other is drifting away from it.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 并列结构

## 生词

- determine/dɪˈtɜːrmɪn/vt.查明；确定
- opposite/ˈɑːpəzət/adj.相反的；对面的
- stationary/ˈsteɪʃəneri/adj.静止的；不动的
- drift/drɪft/vi.漂移；漂流
- continent/ˈkɑːntɪnənt/n.大陆；洲

## 主干

主干为「It（形式主语）+ is not possible（系表）+ to determine...（真正主语）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 It is not possible to determine...，It 为形式主语，真正的主语是不定式短语 to determine whether... or whether...。
- 第一个 whether 引导宾语从句作 determine 的宾语：both continents are moving in opposite directions，in opposite directions 为介词短语作状语。
- or 连接第二个 whether 引导的并列宾语从句，其内部又含 and 连接的两个并列分句：one continent is stationary and the other is drifting away from it。
- away from it 为介词短语作状语，修饰 is drifting，表示“逐渐漂离它”。

## 翻译

人们无法确定，两块大陆究竟是正朝相反方向移动，还是一块大陆静止不动、另一块正逐渐漂离而去。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Specialists in history and economics, have shown two things: that the
entries.text:
## 原句

Specialists in history and economics, have shown two things: that the period from 1650 to 1750 was marked by great poverty, and that industrialization certainly did not worsen and may have actually improved the conditions for the majority of the populace.

**标签**：同位语从句 / 并列结构 / 被动语态

## 生词

- economics/ˌiːkəˈnɑːmɪks/n.经济学
- mark/mɑːrk/vt.标志；以……为特征（be marked by）
- poverty/ˈpɑːvərti/n.贫穷；贫困
- industrialization/ɪnˌdʌstriələˈzeɪʃn/n.工业化
- worsen/ˈwɜːrsn/v.（使）恶化；（使）变坏
- populace/ˈpɑːpjələs/n.百姓；民众

## 主干

主干为「Specialists（主）+ have shown（谓）+ two things（宾）」，冒号后接两个并列的 that 同位语从句。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 Specialists in history and economics have shown two things；in history and economics 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 Specialists，主谓之间的逗号构成分隔，不影响结构。
- 冒号后第一个 that 引导同位语从句，解释 two things 的第一点：the period... was marked by great poverty，从句为被动语态（be marked by）。
- and that industrialization... improved the conditions 为第二个并列同位语从句，其谓语为 did not worsen 和 may have improved 的并列结构，may have improved 表示对过去情况的推测。
- for the majority of the populace 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 conditions。

## 翻译

历史学和经济学领域的专家已经证明了两点：其一，1650 年至 1750 年这一时期以普遍贫困为特征；其二，工业化非但没有使大多数民众的境况恶化，实际上反倒可能有所改善。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: At the same time, the American Law Institute—a group of judges, lawyer
entries.text:
## 原句

At the same time, the American Law Institute—a group of judges, lawyers, and academics whose recommendations carry substantial weight—issued new guidelines for tort law stating that companies need not warn customers of obvious dangers or bombard them with a lengthy list of possible ones.

**标签**：插入语 / 定语从句 / 名词性从句

## 生词

- institute/ˈɪnstɪtuːt/n.学会；协会；研究院
- substantial/səbˈstænʃl/adj.大量的；实质性的
- weight/weɪt/n.分量；影响力；（僻）重量
- tort/tɔːrt/n.侵权行为（法律术语）
- guideline/ˈɡaɪdlaɪn/n.指导方针；准则
- bombard/bɑːmˈbɑːrd/vt.轰炸；不断炮轰，大量提供
- lengthy/ˈleŋθi/adj.冗长的；漫长的

## 主干

主干为「the American Law Institute（主）+ issued（谓）+ new guidelines（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 the American Law Institute issued new guidelines，主谓宾结构，At the same time 为时间状语。
- 破折号之间 a group of judges, lawyers, and academics 为插入的同位语，解释说明主语 American Law Institute 的成员构成。
- whose recommendations carry substantial weight 为定语从句，引导词 whose 修饰先行词 a group of judges, lawyers, and academics。
- for tort law 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 guidelines；stating that... 为现在分词短语作后置定语，同样修饰 guidelines。
- stating 后 that 引导宾语从句，从句内 warn 与 bombard 为 need not 之后并列的两个动词原形；ones 指代前文 dangers，possible ones 即「可能存在的危险」。

## 翻译

与此同时，美国法学会——一个由法官、律师和学者组成、其建议颇具分量的机构——发布了新的侵权法指导方针，指出公司无须就明显的危险警告顾客，也无须向他们轰炸般地罗列一长串可能存在的危险。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Some companies are limiting the risk by conducting online transactions
entries.text:
## 原句

Some companies are limiting the risk by conducting online transactions only with established business partners who are given access to the company’s private intranet.

**标签**：非谓语动词 / 定语从句 / 被动语态

## 生词

- transaction/trænˈzækʃn/n.交易；业务
- established/ɪˈstæblɪʃt/adj.已确立的；资深的
- conduct/kənˈdʌkt/vt.进行；实施；（僻）指挥
- access/ˈækses/n.使用权；接触（进入）的机会
- intranet/ˈɪntrənet/n.内联网；（公司）内部网

## 主干

主干为「Some companies（主）+ are limiting（谓）+ the risk（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 Some companies are limiting the risk，主谓宾结构，现在进行时表示当前正在采取的做法。
- by conducting online transactions... 为介词短语作方式状语，说明限制风险的手段；conducting 后接动名词短语作介词 by 的宾语。
- established 为过去分词作前置定语修饰 business partners，意为「已建立（合作关系）的、固定的」。
- who are given access to the company’s private intranet 为定语从句，引导词 who 修饰先行词 business partners，从句谓语 are given 为被动语态；access to 中 to 为介词。

## 翻译

一些公司只与既有的商业伙伴进行在线交易，以此限制风险——这些伙伴被授权使用该公司的专用内部网。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Online culture thinks highly of the notion that the information flowin
entries.text:
## 原句

Online culture thinks highly of the notion that the information flowing onto the screen comes there by specific request. Once commercial promotion begins to fill the screen uninvited, the distinction between the Web and television fades.

**标签**：同位语从句 / 状语从句 / 非谓语动词

## 生词

- notion/ˈnoʊʃn/n.观念；信念
- commercial/kəˈmɜːrʃl/adj.商业的；盈利的
- promotion/prəˈmoʊʃn/n.促销；宣传推广
- uninvited/ˌʌnɪnˈvaɪtɪd/adj.未受邀的；不请自来的
- distinction/dɪˈstɪŋkʃn/n.区别；差异
- fade/feɪd/vi.逐渐消失；褪色

## 主干

第一句主干为「Online culture（主）+ thinks highly of（谓）+ the notion（宾）」；第二句主干为「the distinction（主）+ fades（谓）」。

## 解析

- 第一句主干为 Online culture thinks highly of the notion，think highly of 意为「高度评价、推崇」。
- that the information... comes there by specific request 为同位语从句，由 that 引导，说明 notion 的具体内容。
- 同位语从句内 flowing onto the screen 为现在分词短语作后置定语修饰 the information；by specific request 为介词短语作方式状语，意为「应具体要求」。
- 第二句主干为 the distinction fades；Once commercial promotion begins to fill the screen uninvited 为 once 引导的时间状语从句。
- between the Web and television 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 distinction；uninvited 过去分词（形容词化）作状语，表示「在未受邀请的情况下」。

## 翻译

网络文化高度推崇这样一种观念：流向屏幕的信息都是应具体要求而来的。一旦商业促销不请自来地涌入屏幕，网络与电视之间的区别便不复存在。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The examples of Virtual Vineyards, Amazon.com, and other pioneers show
entries.text:
## 原句

The examples of Virtual Vineyards, Amazon.com, and other pioneers show that a Web site selling the right kind of products with the right mix of interactivity, hospitality, and security will attract online customers.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 非谓语动词

## 生词

- pioneer/ˌpaɪəˈnɪr/n.先驱；开拓者
- interactivity/ˌɪntərækˈtɪvəti/n.交互性
- hospitality/ˌhɑːspɪˈtæləti/n.热情款待；周到服务
- security/sɪˈkjʊrəti/n.安全；保障
- mix/mɪks/n.组合；混合（搭配 a mix of）

## 主干

主干为「The examples（主）+ show（谓）+ that 引导的宾语从句」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 The examples... show + 宾语从句，show 之后由 that 引导的从句充当宾语。
- of Virtual Vineyards, Amazon.com, and other pioneers 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 examples，三个名词并列共用介词 of。
- 宾语从句内主干为 a Web site... will attract online customers，从句用一般将来时；selling the right kind of products 为现在分词短语作后置定语修饰 a Web site。
- with the right mix of interactivity, hospitality, and security 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 products，说明产品应兼具的三种特质组合。

## 翻译

虚拟葡萄园、亚马逊以及其他先驱者的例子表明：一个网站若以恰到好处的交互性、热情服务和安全性来销售合适的产品，就将吸引到网上顾客。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: An invisible border divides those arguing for computers in the classro
entries.text:
## 原句

An invisible border divides those arguing for computers in the classroom on the behalf of students’ career prospects and those arguing for computers in the classroom for broader reasons of radical educational reform.

**标签**：非谓语动词 / 并列结构

## 生词

- invisible/ˌɪnˈvɪzəbl/adj.看不见的；无形的
- border/ˈbɔːrdər/n.边界；分界线
- behalf/bɪˈhæf/n.利益；代表（on behalf of 为了……）
- prospect/ˈprɑːspekt/n.前景；前途（常用复数）
- radical/ˈrædɪkl/adj.激进的；根本的
- career/kəˈrɪr/n.职业；事业

## 主干

主干为「An invisible border（主）+ divides（谓）+ those... and those...（并列宾语）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 An invisible border divides those... and those...，主谓宾结构，宾语是由 and 连接的两个 those（指两类人）。
- arguing for computers in the classroom 为现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰第一个 those；on the behalf of students’ career prospects 为介词短语，说明该方主张用计算机的目的。
- 第二个 those 后同样接 arguing for computers in the classroom 作后置定语，for broader reasons of radical educational reform 说明另一方的理由。
- 两个分词后置定语结构对称并列，形成「为职业前途」与「为激进教育改革」两种立场的鲜明对照。

## 翻译

一条无形的界线将主张在课堂上使用计算机的两类人分隔开来：一类是为了学生的职业前途，另一类则是出于激进教育改革这种更宽泛的理由。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Very few writers on the subject have explored this distinction—indeed,
entries.text:
## 原句

Very few writers on the subject have explored this distinction—indeed, contradiction—which goes to the heart of what is wrong with the campaign to put computers in the classroom.

**标签**：定语从句 / 名词性从句 / 插入语

## 生词

- explore/ɪkˈsplɔːr/vt.探究；深入探讨
- distinction/dɪˈstɪŋkʃn/n.区别；差异
- contradiction/ˌkɑːntrəˈdɪkʃn/n.矛盾；对立
- campaign/kæmˈpeɪn/n.运动；宣传活动
- subject/ˈsʌbdʒɪkt/n.话题；主题；（僻）对象

## 主干

主干为「Very few writers（主）+ have explored（谓）+ this distinction（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 Very few writers... have explored this distinction，主谓宾结构，谓语为现在完成时。
- on the subject 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 writers；indeed, contradiction 为插入语，对 distinction 作递进补充，指出它实为矛盾。
- which goes to the heart of... 为定语从句，引导词 which 修饰先行词 this distinction（contradiction）。
- of what is wrong with the campaign 为介词短语作定语修饰 the heart，其中 what 引导的从句作介词 of 的宾语；to put computers in the classroom 为不定式短语作后置定语修饰 campaign。

## 翻译

关于这一问题，很少有作家探讨过这种区别——实际上是矛盾——而它恰恰切中了「把计算机引入课堂」这场运动的要害。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: An education that aims at getting a student a certain kind of job is a
entries.text:
## 原句

An education that aims at getting a student a certain kind of job is a technical education, justified for reasons radically different from why education is universally required by law.

**标签**：定语从句 / 非谓语动词 / 名词性从句

## 生词

- justify/ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ/vt.证明……正当；为……辩护
- radically/ˈrædɪkli/adv.根本地；彻底地
- universally/ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəli/adv.普遍地；全体地
- technical/ˈteknɪkl/adj.技术的；职业技术性的
- aim/eɪm/vi.旨在；力求（aim at）

## 主干

主干为「An education（主）+ is（系）+ a technical education（表）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 An education... is a technical education，主系表结构。
- that aims at getting a student a certain kind of job 为定语从句，引导词 that 修饰先行词 An education；getting 后接双宾语：a student 为间接宾语，a certain kind of job 为直接宾语。
- justified for reasons... 为过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 a technical education，说明这种教育被认可所依据的理由。
- radically different from why education is universally required by law 中，why 引导的从句作介词 from 的宾语；radically different from 表示两类理由性质截然不同。

## 翻译

旨在让学生获得某种工作的教育是一种技术教育，它所依据的理由，与法律之所以普遍要求人人接受教育的理由截然不同。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: But, for a small group of students, professional training might be the
entries.text:
## 原句

But, for a small group of students, professional training might be the way to go since well-developed skills, all other factors being equal, can be the difference between having a job and not.

**标签**：状语从句 / 独立主格 / 省略

## 生词

- professional/prəˈfeʃənl/adj.职业的；专业的
- well-developed/ˌwel dɪˈveləpt/adj.成熟的；娴熟的
- factor/ˈfæktər/n.因素；要素
- equal/ˈiːkwəl/adj.同等的；相等的

## 主干

主句主干为「professional training（主）+ might be（系）+ the way（表）」；since 从句主干为「well-developed skills（主）+ can be（系）+ the difference（表）」。

## 解析

- 主句主干为 professional training might be the way to go，主系表结构；for a small group of students 为介词短语作范围状语，由逗号与主干隔开。
- since well-developed skills... can be the difference... 为 since 引导的原因状语从句，说明主句判断的依据。
- all other factors being equal 为独立主格结构（名词＋现在分词），插入从句主语与谓语之间，相当于条件状语「在其他条件相同的情况下」。
- the difference between having a job and not 中，between 连接两个并列成分，not 之后省略了 having a job，指「找不到工作」。

## 翻译

但是，对一小部分学生而言，职业培训也许是可行之路，因为只要其他条件相当，娴熟的技能就可能决定一个人能否找到工作。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Declaring that he was opposed to using this unusual animal husbandry t
entries.text:
## 原句

Declaring that he was opposed to using this unusual animal husbandry technique to clone humans, he ordered that federal funds not be used for such an experiment—although no one had proposed to do so—and asked an independent panel of experts chaired by Princeton President Harold Shapiro to report back to the White House in 90 days with recommendations for a national policy on human cloning.

**标签**：非谓语动词 / 名词性从句 / 虚拟语气

## 生词

- oppose/əˈpoʊz/vt.反对（be opposed to）
- husbandry/ˈhʌzbəndri/n.畜牧；饲养（animal husbandry 畜牧业）
- clone/kloʊn/vt.克隆；无性繁殖
- panel/ˈpænl/n.专门小组；专家组
- federal/ˈfedərəl/adj.联邦的；联邦政府的
- recommendation/ˌrekəmenˈdeɪʃn/n.建议；推荐

## 主干

主干为「he（主）+ ordered（谓1）+ and asked（谓2）」，两个并列谓语共用主语 he。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 he ordered that... and asked... to report back...，主语 he 带两个并列谓语 ordered 与 asked。
- 句首 Declaring that... 为现在分词短语作伴随状语，that 引导宾语从句；be opposed to 中 to 为介词，后接动名词短语 using this unusual animal husbandry technique。
- ordered 后 that 引导宾语从句，谓语 not be used 为「(should)＋动词原形」的虚拟语气形式；although no one had proposed to do so 为让步状语从句，插入两个破折号之间。
- chaired by Princeton President Harold Shapiro 为过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 panel；to report back to the White House... with recommendations... 为不定式短语，作 asked 的宾语补足语。

## 翻译

他宣称反对利用这种非同寻常的畜牧技术来克隆人类，并下令联邦资金不得用于此类实验——尽管还没有人提议这样做——同时要求一个由普林斯顿大学校长哈罗德·夏皮罗担任主席的独立专家小组，在 90 天内向白宫提交关于国家人类克隆政策的建议。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The panel has not yet reached agreement on a crucial question, however
entries.text:
## 原句

The panel has not yet reached agreement on a crucial question, however, whether to recommend legislation that would make it a crime for private funding to be used for human cloning.

**标签**：定语从句 / 分隔结构 / 插入语

## 生词

- crucial/ˈkruːʃl/adj.至关重要的；决定性的
- legislation/ˌledʒɪsˈleɪʃn/n.立法；法规
- recommend/ˌrekəˈmend/vt.建议；推荐
- funding/ˈfʌndɪŋ/n.资金；拨款
- private/ˈpraɪvət/adj.私人的；私有的

## 主干

主干为「The panel（主）+ has not yet reached（谓）+ agreement（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 The panel has not yet reached agreement，现在完成时；on a crucial question 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 agreement；however 为插入语，表转折。
- whether to recommend legislation... 为「疑问词＋不定式」结构，作 a crucial question 的同位语，说明问题的内容；它与 question 之间被 however 隔开，构成分隔结构。
- that would make it a crime... 为定语从句，引导词 that 修饰先行词 legislation；it 为形式宾语，真正宾语是 for private funding to be used for human cloning 这一不定式复合结构，a crime 为宾语补足语。

## 翻译

然而，专家组在一个关键问题上尚未达成一致：是否建议立法，将私人资金用于人类克隆的行为定为犯罪。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Science, in practice, depends far less on the experiments it prepares
entries.text:
## 原句

Science, in practice, depends far less on the experiments it prepares than on the preparedness of the minds of the men who watch the experiments.

**标签**：比较结构 / 定语从句 / 插入语

## 生词

- practice/ˈpræktɪs/n.实践；惯例（in practice（僻）实际上）
- preparedness/prɪˈperdənəs/n.有准备；戒备；准备状态
- far/fɑːr/adv.（修饰比较级，僻）……得多；远远
- watch/wɑːtʃ/vt.注视；观察；监视
- depend/dɪˈpend/vi.依赖；取决于（depend on）

## 主干

主干为「Science（主）+ depends on（谓）+ the experiments...than on the preparedness（两个并列介词宾语）」，far less...than 构成比较结构。

## 解析

- 本句主干：Science depends far less on the experiments than on the preparedness of the minds，为 far less...than 比较结构，意为“与其说依赖……不如说依赖……”。
- in practice 为插入语，意为“实际上”，把主语 Science 与谓语分隔开，造成主谓分隔。
- it prepares 为省略了引导词 that/which 的定语从句，修饰先行词 the experiments，意为“它所安排的实验”。
- who watch the experiments 为定语从句，引导词 who 修饰先行词 the men；the preparedness of the minds of the men 为多个 of 短语层层限定。

## 翻译

实际上，科学与其说依赖于它所安排的实验，不如说依赖于观察实验的人是否有思想准备。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The fact that the apple fell down toward the earth and not up into the
entries.text:
## 原句

The fact that the apple fell down toward the earth and not up into the tree answered the question he had been asking himself about those larger fruits of the heavens, the moon and the planets.

**标签**：同位语从句 / 定语从句 / 并列结构

## 生词

- heaven/ˈhevən/n.天空；天堂（the heavens 天体、诸天）
- fruit/fruːt/n.水果；果实；（僻）产物、成果
- planet/ˈplænɪt/n.行星

## 主干

主干为「The fact（主）+ answered（谓）+ the question（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：The fact answered the question，意为“这一事实回答了那个问题”。
- that the apple fell down toward the earth and not up into the tree 为 that 引导的同位语从句，说明 the fact 的具体内容；从句内 and 并列 down toward... 与 up into... 两个介词短语。
- he had been asking himself 为省略引导词 that/which 的定语从句，修饰 the question，谓语为过去完成进行时。
- about those larger fruits of the heavens 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 the question；the moon and the planets 为 those larger fruits of the heavens 的同位语。

## 翻译

苹果向地面落下而不是向树上落去，这一事实回答了他一直在自问的那个问题，即有关天上那些更大的果实——月亮和行星——的问题。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: If experiments are planned and carried out according to plan as faithf
entries.text:
## 原句

If experiments are planned and carried out according to plan as faithfully as the reports in the science journals indicate, then it is perfectly logical for management to expect research to produce results measurable in dollars and cents.

**标签**：状语从句 / 比较结构 / 被动语态

## 生词

- faithfully/ˈfeɪθfəli/adv.忠实地；如实地
- journal/ˈdʒɜːrnl/n.期刊；杂志；日志
- indicate/ˈɪndɪkeɪt/vt.表明；指出；暗示
- logical/ˈlɑːdʒɪkl/adj.合乎逻辑的；合理的
- management/ˈmænɪdʒmənt/n.管理层；资方；管理
- measurable/ˈmeʒərəbl/adj.可测量的；可衡量的
- carry/ˈkæri/vt.执行；实施（carry out 开展；完成）

## 主干

主干为「it（形式主语）+ is（系）+ logical（表）」，真正主语为 for management to expect research to produce results 这一不定式结构。

## 解析

- 本句主干：it is perfectly logical for management to expect research to produce results，it 为形式主语，真正主语是不定式短语 for management to expect...。
- If experiments are planned and carried out according to plan 为 if 引导的条件状语从句，planned 与 carried out 为并列的被动结构。
- as faithfully as the reports in the science journals indicate 为 as...as 比较结构，作程度状语修饰 planned and carried out，表示“如科学期刊报告所显示的那样忠实于计划”。
- measurable in dollars and cents 为形容词短语作后置定语，修饰 results，相当于 results that can be measured in dollars and cents。
- then 为承接副词，与句首的 if 从句呼应，构成“如果……那么……”的逻辑框架。

## 翻译

如果实验像科学期刊报告所表明的那样严格按计划来规划和实施，那么管理层期望研究产生可以用金钱衡量的结果，就完全合乎逻辑。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: It is entirely reasonable for auditors to believe that scientists who
entries.text:
## 原句

It is entirely reasonable for auditors to believe that scientists who know exactly where they are going and how they will get there should not be distracted by the necessity of keeping one eye on the cash register while the other eye is on the microscope.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 定语从句 / 状语从句

## 生词

- auditor/ˈɔːdɪtər/n.审计员；查账员
- distract/dɪˈstrækt/vt.使分心；转移（注意力）
- necessity/nəˈsesəti/n.必要性；必需品
- register/ˈredʒɪstər/n.登记，注册；现金出纳机（cash register，语境僻义）
- microscope/ˈmaɪkrəskoʊp/n.显微镜

## 主干

主干为「It（形式主语）+ is（系）+ reasonable（表）」，真正主语为 for auditors to believe that... 不定式结构。

## 解析

- 本句主干：It is entirely reasonable for auditors to believe that...，it 为形式主语，真正主语是 for auditors to believe 及其宾语从句。
- that scientists...should not be distracted 为 that 引导的宾语从句，作 believe 的宾语；从句谓语 should not be distracted 为被动语态。
- who know exactly where they are going and how they will get there 为定语从句，修饰 scientists；其中 know 后接 where 和 how 引导的两个并列宾语从句。
- of keeping one eye on the cash register 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 the necessity；while the other eye is on the microscope 为 while 引导的状语从句，与“盯着收银机”形成一心二用的对照。

## 翻译

审计人员认为，那些确切知道自己目标何在、并懂得如何实现的科学家，不应该因为必须一只眼盯着现金出纳机、另一只眼盯着显微镜而分散精力，这完全是合乎情理的。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Nor, if regularity and conformity to a standard pattern are as desirab
entries.text:
## 原句

Nor, if regularity and conformity to a standard pattern are as desirable to the scientist as the writing of his papers would appear to reflect, is management to be blamed for discriminating against the “odd balls” among researchers in favor of more conventional thinkers who “work well with the team.”

**标签**：倒装 / 状语从句 / 比较结构

## 生词

- regularity/ˌreɡjuˈlærəti/n.规律性；规则性
- conformity/kənˈfɔːrməti/n.一致；遵从（conformity to 符合）
- desirable/dɪˈzaɪərəbl/adj.可取的；值得拥有的
- reflect/rɪˈflekt/vt.反映；表现；反思
- discriminate/dɪˈskrɪmɪneɪt/vi.歧视；区别对待（discriminate against 歧视）
- conventional/kənˈvenʃənl/adj.传统的；常规的
- blame/bleɪm/vt.责备；归咎（be to blame 应受责备）
- odd/ɑːd/adj.古怪的；奇数的（odd ball 怪人，（僻））

## 主干

主干为「management（主）+ is to be blamed（谓）」，否定词 Nor 置于句首引起部分倒装，if 从句插在 Nor 与主句之间造成分隔。

## 解析

- 本句主干：Nor is management to be blamed for discriminating against the “odd balls”，否定词 Nor 提前，助动词 is 提至主语 management 之前，构成部分倒装。
- if regularity and conformity to a standard pattern are as desirable...as the writing of his papers would appear to reflect 为 if 引导的条件状语从句，插入句中，把 Nor 与主句分隔开。
- 从句内部为 as...as 比较结构：regularity and conformity are as desirable to the scientist as（the writing would appear to reflect），意为“如论文所反映的那样值得追求”。
- for discriminating against...为介词短语表原因；in favor of 意为“偏爱、更青睐”，与 discriminate against 形成“歧视……偏爱……”的对照。
- who “work well with the team.”为定语从句，引导词 who 修饰先行词 more conventional thinkers。

## 翻译

如果科学家对规律性和遵循标准模式的追求，真如他们的论文所显示的那样值得称许，那么管理层歧视研究人员中的“怪人”、偏爱善于“团队协作”的常规思维者，也就无可指责。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: But however amazed our descendants may be at how far from Utopia we we
entries.text:
## 原句

But however amazed our descendants may be at how far from Utopia we were, they will look just like us.

**标签**：状语从句 / 名词性从句

## 生词

- descendant/dɪˈsendənt/n.后代；后裔
- amaze/əˈmeɪzd/vt.使惊奇；使惊愕（amazed adj. 惊讶的）
- however/haʊˈevər/conj.（僻）无论多么；不管怎样（引导让步从句）
- Utopia/juːˈtoʊpiə/n.乌托邦；理想社会

## 主干

主干为「they（主）+ will look（系）+ just like us（表）」，however 引导的让步状语从句提前。

## 解析

- 本句主干：they will look just like us，意为“我们的后代看上去仍将和我们一模一样”。
- however amazed our descendants may be at...为 however 引导的让步状语从句，相当于 no matter how amazed...，从句中 amazed 紧跟 however 之后提前。
- at how far from Utopia we were 为介词短语，说明 amazed 的方面；其中 how 引导的从句作介词 at 的宾语，how far from Utopia 提至从句句首。
- But 位于句首表转折，承接上文的论述。

## 翻译

但是，无论我们的后代对我们离乌托邦如此遥远感到多么惊讶，他们的模样仍将与我们相差无几。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: When a new movement in art attains a certain fashion, it is advisable
entries.text:
## 原句

When a new movement in art attains a certain fashion, it is advisable to find out what its advocates are aiming at, for, however farfetched and unreasonable their principles may seem today, it is possible that in years to come they may be regarded as normal.

**标签**：状语从句 / 名词性从句 / 并列结构

## 生词

- attain/əˈteɪn/vt.达到；获得；实现
- advisable/ədˈvaɪzəbl/adj.明智的；可取的
- advocate/ˈædvəkət/n.拥护者；提倡者
- farfetched/ˌfɑːrˈfetʃt/adj.牵强的；不切实际的
- principle/ˈprɪnsəpl/n.原则；原理；主张
- fashion/ˈfæʃn/n.时尚；流行（attain a certain fashion 风行一时）

## 主干

主干为两个由 for 连接的并列分句：「it is advisable to find out...」+「it is possible that...」，两个 it 均为形式主语。

## 解析

- 本句为 for 连接的并列句：前一分句 it is advisable to find out what...，后一分句 it is possible that...；两个 it 均为形式主语，真正主语分别为不定式短语和 that 从句。
- When a new movement in art attains a certain fashion 为 when 引导的时间状语从句，修饰前一分句。
- what its advocates are aiming at 为 what 引导的宾语从句，作 find out 的宾语。
- however farfetched and unreasonable their principles may seem today 为 however 引导的让步状语从句，插入 for 分句之中，前后由逗号隔开。
- that in years to come they may be regarded as normal 为主语从句，it 为形式主语；in years to come 为时间状语，may be regarded as 为被动结构。

## 翻译

当艺术上的某一新运动风行一时，明智的做法是弄清其倡导者的目标所在；因为无论他们的主张在今天看来多么牵强、多么不合情理，若干年后这些主张仍有可能被视为正常。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: With regard to Futurist poetry, however, the case is rather difficult,
entries.text:
## 原句

With regard to Futurist poetry, however, the case is rather difficult, for whatever Futurist poetry may be—even admitting that the theory on which it is based may be right—it can hardly be classed as Literature.

**标签**：插入语 / 状语从句 / 定语从句

## 生词

- Futurist/ˈfjuːtʃərɪst/n.未来主义者（adj. 未来主义的）
- poetry/ˈpoʊətri/n.诗歌；诗作
- regard/rɪˈɡɑːrd/n.（with regard to，僻）关于；就……而言
- case/keɪs/n.情况；问题；案件
- admit/ədˈmɪt/vt.承认；准许进入
- class/klæs/vt.（僻）把……归类（be classed as 被视为）
- literature/ˈlɪtərətʃər/n.文学；文学作品

## 主干

主干为「the case（主）+ is（系）+ difficult（表）」，for 连接表原因的并列分句 it can hardly be classed as Literature。

## 解析

- 本句主干：the case is rather difficult, for...it can hardly be classed as Literature，为 for 连接的并列复合句，后一分句说明原因。
- With regard to Futurist poetry 为介词短语作范围状语，意为“就未来主义诗歌而言”；however 为插入语，表转折。
- whatever Futurist poetry may be 为 whatever 引导的让步状语从句，插在 for 分句之中；它与 even admitting that...一起被两个破折号标示为插入成分。
- even admitting that the theory...may be right 为现在分词短语作让步性状语，其中 that 引导宾语从句作 admitting 的宾语。
- on which it is based 为“介词＋which”定语从句，修饰 the theory；it 代指 Futurist poetry，be based on 的介词 on 因关系代词前置而被提前。

## 翻译

然而，就未来主义诗歌而言，情况却相当难以定论；因为不管未来主义诗歌究竟为何物——即使承认其理论基础可能正确——它也很难被归入文学之列。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The coming of age of the postwar baby boom and an entry of women into
entries.text:
## 原句

The coming of age of the postwar baby boom and an entry of women into the male-dominated job market have limited the opportunities of teenagers who are already questioning the heavy personal sacrifices involved in climbing Japan’s rigid social ladder to good schools and jobs.

**标签**：非谓语动词 / 定语从句 / 并列结构

## 生词

- boom/buːm/n.激增；繁荣（baby boom 生育高峰）
- dominate/ˈdɑːmɪneɪt/vt.支配；主导（male-dominated 男性主导的）
- entry/ˈentri/n.进入；入场；条目
- sacrifice/ˈsækrɪfaɪs/n.牺牲；献祭（v. 牺牲）
- involve/ɪnˈvɑːlv/vt.涉及；使卷入（be involved in 与……有关）
- rigid/ˈrɪdʒɪd/adj.僵化的；严格的；刚性的
- ladder/ˈlædər/n.梯子；（social ladder，僻）社会阶梯、晋升途径

## 主干

主干为「The coming of age and an entry（并列主语）+ have limited（谓）+ the opportunities（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：The coming of age...and an entry...have limited the opportunities，两个名词化短语作并列主语，谓语用复数形式 have limited。
- of the postwar baby boom 与 of women into the male-dominated job market 分别为 the coming of age 和 an entry 的后置定语；male-dominated 为复合形容词，修饰 job market。
- who are already questioning...为定语从句，引导词 who 修饰先行词 teenagers。
- involved in climbing...为过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 the heavy personal sacrifices，相当于 sacrifices that are involved in...。
- climbing Japan’s rigid social ladder 为动名词短语作介词 in 的宾语；to good schools and jobs 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 social ladder。

## 翻译

战后生育高峰一代的长大成年，加上女性进入由男性主导的就业市场，限制了日本青少年的机会；而青少年们早已在质疑，为攀爬日本那条通往好学校和好工作的僵化社会阶梯，个人要付出何等沉重的牺牲。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: While often praised by foreigners for its emphasis on the basics, Japa
entries.text:
## 原句

While often praised by foreigners for its emphasis on the basics, Japanese education tends to stress test taking and mechanical learning over creativity and self-expression.

**标签**：状语从句 / 省略 / 并列结构

## 生词

- emphasis/ˈemfəsɪs/n.强调；重视（emphasis on 对……的强调）
- basics/ˈbeɪsɪks/n.基础；基本内容（the basics 基础知识）
- stress/stres/vt.（僻）强调；着重（n. 压力）
- mechanical/məˈkænɪkl/adj.机械的；呆板的
- over/ˈoʊvər/prep.（僻）胜过；而不是（stress A over B 更重视 A）

## 主干

主干为「Japanese education（主）+ tends to stress（谓）+ test taking and mechanical learning（宾）」，over 引出被轻视的对比对象。

## 解析

- 本句主干：Japanese education tends to stress test taking and mechanical learning over creativity and self-expression，意为“重视……而轻视……”。
- While often praised by foreigners...为 while 引导的让步状语从句，省略了主语和 be 动词（=While it is often praised...），属状语从句的省略。
- praised by foreigners 为被动语态；for its emphasis on the basics 为介词短语作原因状语，on the basics 修饰 emphasis。
- test taking and mechanical learning 与 creativity and self-expression 为两组并列名词短语，分别作 stress 的宾语和 over 的宾语，形成鲜明对比。

## 翻译

尽管日本教育因重视基础知识而经常受到外国人称赞，但该国教育往往强调应试和机械式学习，更甚于创造力与自我表达。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: With economic growth has come centralization; fully 76 percent of Japa
entries.text:
## 原句

With economic growth has come centralization; fully 76 percent of Japan’s 119 million citizens live in cities where community and the extended family have been abandoned in favor of isolated, two-generation households.

**标签**：倒装 / 定语从句 / 被动语态

## 生词

- centralization/ˌsentrələˈzeɪʃn/n.集中；集中化
- citizen/ˈsɪtɪzn/n.公民；国民；市民
- community/kəˈmjuːnəti/n.社区；团体；共同体
- extended/ɪkˈstendɪd/adj.扩大的；延伸的（extended family 大家庭）
- abandon/əˈbændən/vt.抛弃；舍弃
- isolate/ˈaɪsəleɪt/vt.使孤立；使隔离
- household/ˈhaʊshoʊld/n.家庭；住户

## 主干

分号前为完全倒装，主干为「centralization（主）+ has come（谓）」；分号后主干为「76 percent of...citizens（主）+ live（谓）+ in cities（地点状语）」。

## 解析

- 分号前为完全倒装句：介词短语 With economic growth 提前作状语，主语 centralization 后置，谓语 has come 置于主语之前，表示「随着经济增长出现了集中化」。
- 分号后主干为 76 percent of Japan’s 119 million citizens live in cities，fully 为程度副词，强调比例之高。
- where community and the extended family have been abandoned 为 where 引导的定语从句，修饰先行词 cities，where 相当于 in which，谓语为被动语态。
- in favor of isolated, two-generation households 为介词短语，与 abandoned 呼应，表示「取而代之的是与外界隔绝的两代同堂的小家庭」。

## 翻译

随着经济的增长出现了集中化；日本的1.19亿国民中足足有76%居住在城市，而在这些城市里，社区和大家庭已被抛弃，取而代之的是与外界隔绝的两代同堂的小家庭。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Urban Japanese have long endured lengthy commutes (travels to and from
entries.text:
## 原句

Urban Japanese have long endured lengthy commutes (travels to and from work) and crowded living conditions, but as the old group and family values weaken, the discomfort is beginning to tell.

**标签**：并列结构 / 状语从句

## 生词

- urban/ˈɜːrbən/adj.城市的；都市的
- endure/ɪnˈdʊr/vt.忍受；容忍；持久
- lengthy/ˈleŋθi/adj.漫长的；冗长的
- commute/kəˈmjuːt/n.通勤；上下班往返的路程
- value/ˈvæljuː/n.价值观（常用复数）；价值
- discomfort/dɪsˈkʌmfərt/n.不适；令人不适之事
- tell/tel/v.（僻）产生效果；（负面影响）显现；讲，告诉

## 主干

主干为 but 连接的并列句：前一分句「Urban Japanese（主）+ have endured（谓）+ commutes and...conditions（宾）」；后一分句「the discomfort（主）+ is beginning to tell（谓）」。

## 解析

- 全句由 but 连接两个并列分句：前一分句主干为 Urban Japanese have long endured lengthy commutes and crowded living conditions，long 为副词作状语，括号内容是对 commutes 的解释说明。
- as the old group and family values weaken 为 as 引导的时间（兼原因）状语从句，修饰 but 之后的分句，意为「随着旧的集体观和家庭观日趋淡漠」。
- 后一分句主干为 the discomfort is beginning to tell，其中 tell 为熟词僻义，指「（负面后果）开始显现、产生实际影响」。

## 翻译

城市里的日本人长期忍受着漫长的通勤（上下班往返）和拥挤的居住条件，但随着旧的集体观和家庭价值观日渐淡漠，这种不适感正开始显现出来。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Owing to the remarkable development in mass-communications, people eve
entries.text:
## 原句

Owing to the remarkable development in mass-communications, people everywhere are feeling new wants and are being exposed to new customs and ideas, while governments are often forced to introduce still further innovations for the reasons given above.

**标签**：并列结构 / 状语从句 / 被动语态

## 生词

- remarkable/rɪˈmɑːrkəbl/adj.显著的；非凡的；值得注意的
- mass-communication/ˌmæs kəˌmjuːnɪˈkeɪʃn/n.大众传播；大众传媒
- want/wɑːnt/n.（僻）需要；需求（常用复数）；缺乏
- expose/ɪkˈspoʊz/vt.使接触；使暴露于；揭露
- custom/ˈkʌstəm/n.风俗；习惯；惯例
- innovation/ˌɪnəˈveɪʃn/n.革新；创新；新事物

## 主干

主干为「people（主）+ are feeling...and are being exposed to...（并列谓语）+ new wants 与 new customs and ideas（宾语）」。

## 解析

- 主干为 people are feeling new wants and are being exposed to new customs and ideas，and 连接两个现在进行时谓语，第二个谓语为被动语态，表示「正不断产生新需求、正接触到新习俗与观念」。
- Owing to the remarkable development in mass-communications 为介词短语作原因状语，说明上述变化产生的原因。
- while governments are often forced to introduce still further innovations 为 while 引导的对比状语从句，与主句形成民众与政府两方面的对照，其中 be forced to 为被动语态。
- for the reasons given above 为介词短语作原因状语，given above 为过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 reasons，意为「由于上述原因」。

## 翻译

由于大众传播的显著发展，世界各地的人们都在产生新的需求，并接触到新的习俗和观念；而政府出于上述原因，往往不得不推行进一步的革新。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: For example, in the early industrialized countries of Europe the proce
entries.text:
## 原句

For example, in the early industrialized countries of Europe the process of industrialization—with all the far-reaching changes in social patterns that followed— was spread over nearly a century, whereas nowadays a developing nation may undergo the same process in a decade or so.

**标签**：插入语 / 定语从句 / 状语从句

## 生词

- industrialize/ɪnˈdʌstriəlaɪz/v.（使）工业化
- industrialization/ɪnˌdʌstriələˈzeɪʃn/n.工业化
- far-reaching/ˌfɑːr ˈriːtʃɪŋ/adj.影响深远的；广泛的
- pattern/ˈpætərn/n.模式；方式；图案
- undergo/ˌʌndərˈɡoʊ/vt.经历；经受；遭受
- whereas/ˌwerˈæz/conj.然而；反之；鉴于

## 主干

主干为「the process of industrialization（主）+ was spread（谓）+ over nearly a century（状语）」；whereas 后分句主干为「a developing nation（主）+ may undergo（谓）+ the same process（宾）」。

## 解析

- 主干为 the process of industrialization was spread over nearly a century，谓语 was spread over 为被动语态，表示「工业化进程延展持续了近一个世纪」。
- 两个破折号之间为插入语 with all the far-reaching changes in social patterns that followed，补充说明工业化所伴随的种种变化。
- that followed 为定语从句，引导词 that 修饰先行词 changes，意为「随之而来的」；in social patterns 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 changes。
- whereas 引导对比状语从句，将「欧洲早期工业化国家耗时近百年」与「如今发展中国家约十年完成」两种情况进行对照。

## 翻译

例如，在欧洲早期工业化国家中，工业化进程——连同随之而来的社会模式的种种深远变化——延续了将近一个世纪；而如今，一个发展中国家大约用十年时间就可能经历同样的进程。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Nevertheless, the word “amateur” does carry a connotation that the per
entries.text:
## 原句

Nevertheless, the word “amateur” does carry a connotation that the person concerned is not fully integrated into the scientific community and, in particular, may not fully share its values.

**标签**：同位语从句 / 并列结构 / 插入语

## 生词

- nevertheless/ˌnevərðəˈles/adv.然而；不过；尽管如此
- amateur/ˈæmətər/n.业余爱好者；外行（adj. 业余的）
- connotation/ˌkɑːnəˈteɪʃn/n.内涵；隐含意义；言外之意
- integrate/ˈɪntɪɡreɪt/vt.使融入；使成整体
- concerned/kənˈsɜːrnd/adj.（僻）有关的（作后置定语）；担忧的

## 主干

主干为「the word “amateur”（主）+ does carry（谓，does 表强调）+ a connotation（宾）」。

## 解析

- 主干为 the word “amateur” does carry a connotation，助动词 does 置于动词前表示强调，意为「确实带有」。
- that the person concerned...may not fully share its values 为 that 引导的同位语从句，具体说明 connotation（含义）的内容。
- 同位语从句内部，and 并列两个谓语 is not fully integrated into the scientific community 和 may not fully share its values；in particular 为插入语，强调后者。
- concerned 为过去分词作后置定语，修饰 the person，意为「有关的、相关的」，注意不可误解为前置形容词。

## 翻译

然而，“业余爱好者”一词确实带有这样的含义：相关人员尚未完全融入科学界，尤其可能并不完全认同科学界的价值观。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: As the Internet becomes more and more commercialized, it is in the int
entries.text:
## 原句

As the Internet becomes more and more commercialized, it is in the interest of business to universalize access—after all, the more people online, the more potential customers there are.

**标签**：状语从句 / 比较结构 / 省略

## 生词

- commercialize/kəˈmɜːrʃəlaɪz/vt.使商业化；使商品化
- universalize/ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəlaɪz/vt.使普遍化；使普及
- access/ˈækses/n.使用权；接入；获取途径
- interest/ˈɪntrəst/n.（常用复数）利益；兴趣
- potential/pəˈtenʃl/adj.潜在的；可能的（n. 潜力）

## 主干

主干为「it（形式主语）+ is（系）+ in the interest of business（表语）」，真正主语是不定式 to universalize access。

## 解析

- 主干为 it is in the interest of business to universalize access，it 为形式主语，不定式短语 to universalize access 为真正主语，in the interest of... 意为「符合……的利益」。
- As the Internet becomes more and more commercialized 为 as 引导的时间（兼原因）状语从句，其中 more and more 表示「越来越」。
- 破折号之后由 after all 引出论据，主体为 the more people online, the more potential customers there are，属「the+比较级..., the+比较级...」结构，前一分句省略了谓语。

## 翻译

随着互联网日益商业化，让更多人接入网络符合商界的利益——毕竟，上网的人越多，潜在的顾客就越多。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Sad to say, this project has turned out to be mostly low-level finding
entries.text:
## 原句

Sad to say, this project has turned out to be mostly low-level findings about factual errors and spelling and grammar mistakes, combined with lots of head-scratching puzzlement about what in the world those readers really want.

**标签**：插入语 / 名词性从句 / 并列结构

## 生词

- factual/ˈfæktʃuəl/adj.事实的；真实的
- low-level/ˌloʊ ˈlevl/adj.低水平的；层次低的
- finding/ˈfaɪndɪŋ/n.（常用复数）调查结果；研究发现
- combine/kəmˈbaɪn/v.结合；联合
- head-scratching/ˈhed skrætʃɪŋ/adj.令人挠头的；令人困惑的
- puzzlement/ˈpʌzlmənt/n.困惑；迷惑

## 主干

主干为「this project（主）+ has turned out（系）+ to be...findings（表语）」，combined with... 为分词短语作补充成分。

## 解析

- 主干为 this project has turned out to be mostly low-level findings，turn out to be 意为「结果是、最终成为」，findings 指「调查所得的发现」。
- Sad to say 为不定式短语构成的评注性插入语，意为「遗憾的是」，修饰整个句子。
- about factual errors and spelling and grammar mistakes 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 findings，and 连接并列名词短语。
- combined with... 为过去分词短语作补充，相当于 and together with；what in the world those readers really want 为 what 引导的宾语从句作介词 about 的宾语，in the world 用于强调，意为「究竟」。

## 翻译

遗憾的是，这个项目最终得出的结果大多是关于事实错误和拼写、语法错误的低水平发现，此外还夹杂着大量令人挠头的困惑：那些读者究竟想要什么。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: There exists a social and cultural disconnect between journalists and
entries.text:
## 原句

There exists a social and cultural disconnect between journalists and their readers, which helps explain why the “standard templates” of the newsroom seem alien to many readers.

**标签**：倒装 / 定语从句 / 名词性从句

## 生词

- disconnect/dɪskəˈnekt/n.（僻）脱节；隔阂（原为动词「使断开」）
- journalist/ˈdʒɜːrnəlɪst/n.新闻记者；新闻工作者
- template/ˈtemplət/n.模板；样板；固定模式
- newsroom/ˈnuːzruːm/n.新闻编辑室
- alien/ˈeɪliən/adj.（僻）陌生的；格格不入的；外国的（n. 外星人）

## 主干

主干为存在句「there（引导词）+ exists（谓）+ a disconnect（主语）」，其后 which 引导非限制性定语从句。

## 解析

- There exists a social and cultural disconnect... 为 there be 型存在句的变体，实义动词 exists 前置、真正主语 a social and cultural disconnect 后置，谓语位于主语之前。
- which helps explain why... 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，which 指代前面整个句子所述现象（记者与读者之间的脱节）。
- why the “standard templates” of the newsroom seem alien to many readers 为 why 引导的宾语从句，作 explain 的宾语；alien 为形容词，alien to 表示「令……感到陌生、格格不入」。

## 翻译

新闻记者与他们的读者之间存在一种社会和文化上的隔阂，这有助于解释为什么新闻编辑室的“标准模式”对许多读者来说显得那么陌生。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The astonishing distrust of the news media isn’t rooted in inaccuracy
entries.text:
## 原句

The astonishing distrust of the news media isn’t rooted in inaccuracy or poor reportorial skills but in the daily clash of world views between reporters and their readers.

**标签**：并列结构 / 被动语态

## 生词

- astonishing/əˈstɑːnɪʃɪŋ/adj.令人惊讶的；惊人的
- distrust/dɪsˈtrʌst/n.不信任；怀疑
- root/ruːt/vt.（僻）使扎根；使根源于（be rooted in 源于）
- inaccuracy/ɪnˈækjərəsi/n.不准确；误差
- reportorial/ˌrepəˈtɔːriəl/adj.记者的；新闻报道的
- clash/klæʃ/n.冲突；抵触；碰撞

## 主干

主干为「The...distrust（主）+ isn’t rooted in...but in...（并列谓语）」，属 not...but... 结构。

## 解析

- 主干为 The astonishing distrust isn’t rooted in...but in...，即 not A but B 的并列结构，两个介词短语同受 rooted in 支配，意为「并非源于……而是源于……」。
- of the news media 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 distrust；isn’t rooted in 为被动语态，root 在此为熟词僻义。
- the daily clash of world views between reporters and their readers 中，of world views 与 between reporters and their readers 为层层后置定语，分别说明 clash 的内容与对立双方。

## 翻译

人们对新闻媒体这种令人惊讶的不信任，并非源于报道失实或拙劣的报道技巧，而是源于记者与读者之间日常的世界观冲突。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: I have discovered, as perhaps Kelsey will after her much-publicized re
entries.text:
## 原句

I have discovered, as perhaps Kelsey will after her much-publicized resignation from the editorship of She after a build-up of stress, that abandoning the doctrine of “juggling your life”, and making the alternative move into “downshifting” bring with it far greater rewards than financial success and social status.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 状语从句 / 省略

## 生词

- publicize/ˈpʌblɪsaɪz/vt.宣传；广而告之（much-publicized 大肆宣传的）
- resignation/ˌrezɪɡˈneɪʃn/n.辞职；辞呈
- editorship/ˈedɪtərʃɪp/n.主编职位；编辑工作
- build-up/ˈbɪld ʌp/n.逐渐积累；聚积
- doctrine/ˈdɑːktrɪn/n.信条；教条；主义
- juggle/ˈdʒʌɡl/vt.同时应付（多项事务）；兼顾；耍杂耍
- downshift/ˈdaʊnʃɪft/v.（为减压）放慢生活节奏；（使）降档
- alternative/ɔːlˈtɜːrnətɪv/adj.替代性的；可供选择的（n. 替代方案）

## 主干

主干为「I（主）+ have discovered（谓）+ that 引导的宾语从句（宾语）」；从句内主语为两个并列动名词短语，谓语为 bring。

## 解析

- 主干为 I have discovered that...，that 引导宾语从句；as perhaps Kelsey will... 为 as 引导的方式状语从句，will 后省略 discover，插在谓语与宾语之间造成分隔。
- as 从句中，after her much-publicized resignation from the editorship of She 说明凯尔希辞去《她》杂志主编一事，after a build-up of stress 补充辞职前压力不断累积的背景。
- 宾语从句内，abandoning the doctrine... 与 making the alternative move... 为 and 连接的两个并列动名词短语，共同作从句主语，谓语为 bring。
- bring with it far greater rewards 中的 it 指代「转向 downshifting」这一选择，宾语 rewards 因较长而移至 with it 之后；far greater...than... 为比较结构，than 引出比较对象。

## 翻译

我发现——正像凯尔西在压力不断累积之后大张旗鼓地辞去《她》杂志主编职务时或许也会发现的那样——放弃“连轴应付生活”的信条、转而选择“放慢生活节奏”，所带来的回报远远大于经济上的成功和社会地位。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: As was discussed before, it was not until the 19th century that the ne
entries.text:
## 原句

As was discussed before, it was not until the 19th century that the newspaper became the dominant pre-electronic medium, following in the wake of the pamphlet and the book and in the company of the periodical.

**标签**：强调句 / 定语从句 / 非谓语动词

## 生词

- dominant/ˈdɑːmənənt/adj.占主导地位的；显性的
- medium/ˈmiːdiəm/n.媒介，媒体（复数 media）
- pamphlet/ˈpæmflət/n.小册子
- periodical/ˌpɪriˈɑːdɪkl/n.期刊，杂志
- wake/weɪk/n.（僻）尾迹，余波（in the wake of 紧随……之后）
- company/ˈkʌmpəni/n.陪伴，同伴（in the company of 在……陪伴下）；（熟）公司

## 主干

主干为强调句 it was not until... that...，核心是「the newspaper（主）+ became（系）+ the dominant pre-electronic medium（表）」。

## 解析

- 本句为 not until 的强调句型：it was not until the 19th century that...，被强调的部分是时间状语 the 19th century。
- As was discussed before 为 as 引导的非限制性定语从句，as 指代整个主句的内容，意为“正如”，置于句首。
- following in the wake of... and in the company of... 为现在分词短语作伴随状语，其逻辑主语是 the newspaper。
- in the wake of the pamphlet and the book 与 in the company of the periodical 为两个并列的介词短语，共同由 following 支配。

## 翻译

正如前文所讨论的，直到 19 世纪，报纸才继小册子和书籍之后、与期刊相伴，成为电子时代之前占主导地位的媒介。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: It is generally recognized, however, that the introduction of the comp
entries.text:
## 原句

It is generally recognized, however, that the introduction of the computer in the early 20th century, followed by the invention of the integrated circuit during the 1960s, radically changed the process, although its impact on the media was not immediately apparent.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 被动语态 / 状语从句

## 生词

- recognize/ˈrekəɡnaɪz/vt.公认，认可；认出
- introduction/ˌɪntrəˈdʌkʃn/n.（熟）引进，采用；介绍
- integrate/ˈɪntɪɡreɪt/vt.使集成，使合并
- circuit/ˈsɜːrkɪt/n.电路；环行
- radically/ˈrædɪkli/adv.根本地，彻底地
- apparent/əˈpærənt/adj.明显的；表面上的

## 主干

it 为形式主语，真正主语是 that 引导的主语从句；从句核心为「the introduction（主）+ changed（谓）+ the process（宾）」。

## 解析

- It is generally recognized that... 中 it 为形式主语，that 从句为真正主语；is recognized 为被动结构，意为“人们普遍认为”。
- 主语从句核心为 the introduction of the computer... radically changed the process；of the computer 作后置定语，in the early 20th century 作时间定语。
- followed by the invention of the integrated circuit during the 1960s 为过去分词短语，补充说明 introduction，并将主语与谓语分隔。
- although its impact on the media was not immediately apparent 为 although 引导的让步状语从句，its 指代前述技术变革。

## 翻译

然而，人们普遍认为，20 世纪初计算机的引入以及随后 20 世纪 60 年代集成电路的发明，从根本上改变了这一进程，尽管其对媒体的影响在当时并未立即显现。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: What they found, in attempting to model thought, is that the human bra
entries.text:
## 原句

What they found, in attempting to model thought, is that the human brain's roughly one hundred billion nerve cells are much more talented—and human perception far more complicated—than previously imagined.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 比较结构 / 省略

## 生词

- model/ˈmɑːdl/vt.（僻）模拟，仿造；做模型
- perception/pərˈsepʃn/n.感知，知觉；看法
- nerve/nɜːrv/n.神经；（熟）勇气
- talented/ˈtæləntɪd/adj.有才能的，能干的
- roughly/ˈrʌfli/adv.大约，粗略地

## 主干

主干为「What they found（主语从句）+ is（系）+ that 引导的表语从句」，整体为主系表结构。

## 解析

- What they found 为主语从句，what 在从句中作 found 的宾语；is 后由 that 引导表语从句，构成主系表框架。
- in attempting to model thought 为介词短语作插入语，attempting 为动名词，交代“发现”产生的背景。
- 表语从句核心为 nerve cells are much more talented than previously imagined，属 more...than 比较结构，than 从句后省略了 they were。
- 破折号内 and human perception far more complicated 为并列的省略结构，补全为 human perception (is) far more complicated (than previously imagined)。

## 翻译

在试图模拟思维的过程中，他们发现，人脑约一千亿个神经细胞比人们原先想象的要有才能得多——而人类的感知也远比原先想象的复杂。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Since the dawn of human ingenuity, people have devised ever more cunni
entries.text:
## 原句

Since the dawn of human ingenuity, people have devised ever more cunning tools to cope with work that is dangerous, boring, burdensome, or just plain nasty.

**标签**：非谓语动词 / 定语从句 / 并列结构

## 生词

- ingenuity/ˌɪndʒəˈnuːəti/n.独创性，创造力
- devise/dɪˈvaɪz/vt.设计，发明，想出
- cunning/ˈkʌnɪŋ/adj.精巧的；（熟）狡猾的
- cope/koʊp/vi.（with）应对，处理
- burdensome/ˈbɜːrdnsəm/adj.繁重的，难以负担的
- nasty/ˈnæsti/adj.令人厌恶的；危险的
- dawn/dɔːn/n.（僻）开端，曙光；黎明

## 主干

主干为「people（主）+ have devised（谓）+ ever more cunning tools（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：people have devised ever more cunning tools；ever more 修饰 cunning，意为“越来越精巧”，与现在完成时连用。
- Since the dawn of human ingenuity 为介词短语作时间状语，since 与句中现在完成时 have devised 相呼应。
- to cope with work 为不定式短语作目的状语。
- that is dangerous, boring, burdensome, or just plain nasty 为 that 引导的定语从句修饰 work，从句内四个表语由 or 并列，plain 起强调作用。

## 翻译

自人类萌发创造力之初，人们便不断设计出越来越精巧的工具，去应对那些危险、乏味、繁重，或者简直令人厌恶的工作。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: And thanks to the continual miniaturization of electronics and micro-m
entries.text:
## 原句

And thanks to the continual miniaturization of electronics and micro-mechanics, there are already robot systems that can perform some kinds of brain and bone surgery with submillimeter accuracy—far greater precision than highly skilled physicians can achieve with their hands alone.

**标签**：定语从句 / 比较结构

## 生词

- miniaturization/ˌmɪniətʃərəˈzeɪʃn/n.小型化，微型化
- accuracy/ˈækjərəsi/n.准确性，精确度
- precision/prɪˈsɪʒn/n.精确，精密
- physician/fɪˈzɪʃn/n.医师，内科医生
- surgery/ˈsɜːrdʒəri/n.外科手术；外科
- perform/pərˈfɔːrm/vt.做，实施（手术）；表演

## 主干

主干为 there be 存在句「there are（谓）+ robot systems（主）」，机器人系统的能力内容由后置定语从句交代。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 there be 存在句：there are already robot systems。
- thanks to the continual miniaturization of electronics and micro-mechanics 为介词短语作原因状语，thanks to 意为“多亏、由于”。
- that can perform some kinds of brain and bone surgery with submillimeter accuracy 为 that 引导的定语从句，修饰 robot systems，with 短语在从句中作方式状语。
- 破折号后 far greater precision than highly skilled physicians can achieve with their hands alone 为名词短语，补充说明 accuracy，内含 than 引导的比较从句。

## 翻译

得益于电子器件和微机械装置的不断小型化，如今已经出现了能够以亚毫米级精度实施某些脑科和骨科手术的机器人系统——其精确度远超高明的外科医生仅凭双手所能达到的水平。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The Supreme Court’s decisions on physician-assisted suicide carry impo
entries.text:
## 原句

The Supreme Court’s decisions on physician-assisted suicide carry important implications for how medicine seeks to relieve dying patients of pain and suffering.

**标签**：名词性从句

## 生词

- supreme/suːˈpriːm/adj.最高的，至高无上的
- implication/ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃn/n.（熟）可能的影响，牵连；含义
- suicide/ˈsuːɪsaɪd/n.自杀
- physician/fɪˈzɪʃn/n.医师，内科医生
- relieve/rɪˈliːv/vt.减轻，缓解（relieve sb of sth 解除某人的……）

## 主干

主干为「decisions（主）+ carry（谓）+ important implications（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：The Supreme Court’s decisions... carry important implications；谓语 carry 意为“带有、具有”。
- on physician-assisted suicide 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 decisions。
- for how medicine seeks to relieve dying patients of pain and suffering 中 how 引导宾语从句，作介词 for 的宾语；从句内 relieve...of... 为固定搭配。

## 翻译

最高法院就医生协助自杀问题所作的裁决，对医学如何设法解除垂死病人的疼痛与痛苦具有重要意义。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Although it ruled that there is no constitutional right to physician-a
entries.text:
## 原句

Although it ruled that there is no constitutional right to physician-assisted suicide, the Court in effect supported the medical principle of “double effect”, a centuries-old moral principle holding that an action having two effects—a good one that is intended and a harmful one that is foreseen—is permissible if the actor intends only the good effect.

**标签**：状语从句 / 名词性从句 / 非谓语动词

## 生词

- rule/ruːl/vt.（僻）裁定，判决；统治
- constitutional/ˌkɑːnstɪˈtuːʃənl/adj.宪法的；体质上的
- permissible/pərˈmɪsəbl/adj.可允许的，许可的
- intend/ɪnˈtend/vt.打算，意图
- foresee/fɔːrˈsiː/vt.预见，预知
- hold/hoʊld/vt.（僻）认为，主张；持有

## 主干

主干为「the Court（主）+ supported（谓）+ the medical principle（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：the Court in effect supported the medical principle of “double effect”；in effect 意为“实际上”。
- Although it ruled that there is no constitutional right... 为 although 引导的让步状语从句，其中 that 引导宾语从句作 ruled 的宾语。
- a centuries-old moral principle holding that... 为 “double effect” 的同位语；holding that 为现在分词短语作后置定语，that 引导宾语从句。
- 该宾语从句核心为 an action... is permissible；破折号间 a good one that is intended and a harmful one that is foreseen 为 two effects 的同位语，内含两个 that 定语从句。
- if the actor intends only the good effect 为 if 引导的条件状语从句。

## 翻译

尽管法院裁定宪法并未赋予医生协助自杀的权利，但它实际上支持了医学上的“双重效果”原则。这一传承数百年的道德原则认为：一个行为若会产生两种效果，即意图实现的良好效果与可以预见的危害效果，那么只要行为者只追求良好的效果，该行为便是被允许的。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: On another level, many in the medical community acknowledge that the a
entries.text:
## 原句

On another level, many in the medical community acknowledge that the assisted-suicide debate has been fueled in part by the despair of patients for whom modern medicine has prolonged the physical agony of dying.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 被动语态 / 定语从句

## 生词

- acknowledge/əkˈnɑːlɪdʒ/vt.承认；致谢
- fuel/ˈfjuːəl/vt.（僻）加剧，激起；给……加燃料
- despair/dɪˈsper/n.绝望
- prolong/prəˈlɔːŋ/vt.延长，拉长
- agony/ˈæɡəni/n.极度痛苦，煎熬

## 主干

主干为「many（主）+ acknowledge（谓）+ that 引导的宾语从句」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：many... acknowledge that...；many 为代词作主语，that 引导宾语从句作 acknowledge 的宾语。
- in the medical community 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 many。
- 宾语从句内 the assisted-suicide debate has been fueled in part by the despair of patients 为被动语态，fuel 为熟词僻义，意为“助长、激起”。
- for whom modern medicine has prolonged the physical agony of dying 为“介词 + whom”引导的定语从句，修饰 patients，for 在语义上与 prolonged 相呼应。

## 翻译

在另一个层面上，医疗界的许多人都承认，关于医生协助自杀的争论之所以升温，部分源于病人的绝望情绪——现代医学延长了这些病人临终时肉体上的痛苦。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The role of natural selection in evolution was formulated only a littl
entries.text:
## 原句

The role of natural selection in evolution was formulated only a little more than a hundred years ago, and the selective role of the environment in shaping and maintaining the behavior of the individual is only beginning to be recognized and studied.

**标签**：并列结构 / 被动语态

## 生词

- formulate/ˈfɔːrmjuleɪt/vt.系统阐述；制定
- evolution/ˌiːvəˈluːʃn/n.进化，演化；发展
- selective/sɪˈlektɪv/adj.选择的，选择性的
- maintain/meɪnˈteɪn/vt.保持，维持；（熟）坚称
- individual/ˌɪndɪˈvɪdʒuəl/n.个人，个体

## 主干

主干为 and 并列的两个分句：「the role... was formulated」与「the selective role... is beginning to be recognized and studied」。

## 解析

- and 连接两个并列分句；第一分句为 the role of natural selection in evolution was formulated only a little more than a hundred years ago，属被动语态。
- 第一分句中 of natural selection 与 in evolution 均为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 the role。
- 第二分句中 in shaping and maintaining the behavior of the individual 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 the selective role，shaping 与 maintaining 为动名词并列。
- 句末 to be recognized and studied 为不定式被动结构作 beginning 的宾语，only 强调“才刚刚开始”。

## 翻译

自然选择在进化中的作用，仅在一百多年前才得到阐明；而环境在塑造和保持个体行为方面的选择性作用，则才刚刚开始被认识和研究。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: As the interaction between organism and environment has come to be und
entries.text:
## 原句

As the interaction between organism and environment has come to be understood, however, effects once assigned to states of mind, feelings, and traits are beginning to be traced to accessible conditions, and a technology of behavior may therefore become available.

**标签**：状语从句 / 非谓语动词 / 被动语态

## 生词

- interaction/ˌɪntərˈækʃn/n.相互作用，交流
- organism/ˈɔːrɡənɪzəm/n.有机体，生物体
- assign/əˈsaɪn/vt.归因于（to）；分配，指派
- trait/treɪt/n.特质，特征，特性
- trace/treɪs/vt.追溯（to）；追踪，查出
- accessible/əkˈsesəbl/adj.可获得的，可接近的

## 主干

主干为 and 并列的两个分句：「effects... are beginning to be traced to accessible conditions」与「a technology of behavior may become available」。

## 解析

- 本句为 and 连接的并列结构：effects... are beginning to be traced to accessible conditions 与 a technology of behavior may therefore become available。
- As the interaction between organism and environment has come to be understood 为 as 引导的时间状语从句，从句内 come to be understood 为被动结构。
- once assigned to states of mind, feelings, and traits 为过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 effects，相当于 which were once assigned to...。
- be assigned to 与 be traced to 均为被动结构；therefore 承接前文，引出“行为科学技术有望出现”的结论。

## 翻译

然而，随着有机体与环境之间的相互作用逐渐为人们所理解，那些曾被归因于心理状态、情感和性格特质的影响，如今开始被追溯到可以考察的环境条件；因此，一种研究行为的科学技术也终将可能出现。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Until these issues are resolved, a technology of behavior will continu
entries.text:
## 原句

Until these issues are resolved, a technology of behavior will continue to be rejected, and with it possibly the only way to solve our problems.

**标签**：状语从句 / 被动语态 / 省略

## 生词

- issue/ˈɪʃuː/n.问题；争论点
- resolve/rɪˈzɑːlv/vt.解决；下决心
- technology/tekˈnɑːlədʒi/n.技术；工艺
- reject/rɪˈdʒekt/vt.拒绝；摒弃
- behavior/bɪˈheɪvjər/n.行为；举止

## 主干

主干为「a technology of behavior（主）+ will continue to be rejected（谓）」，and 之后为承前省略谓语的并列成分。

## 解析

- Until these issues are resolved 为 until 引导的时间状语从句，从句谓语 are resolved 为被动语态，意为「在这些问题得到解决之前」。
- 主干为 a technology of behavior will continue to be rejected，to be rejected 为不定式被动式，continue to do 表示「继续处于某种状态」。
- and with it possibly the only way to solve our problems 为并列结构，与 rejected 相呼应，承接上文省略了 will continue to be；it 回指「行为技术继续遭到排斥」这一情况。
- to solve our problems 为不定式短语作后置定语，修饰 the only way。

## 翻译

在这些问题得到解决之前，行为技术将继续遭到排斥，随之遭到排斥的很可能还有解决我们问题的唯一办法。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: A variety of activities should be organized so that participants can r
entries.text:
## 原句

A variety of activities should be organized so that participants can remain active as long as they want and then go on to something else without feeling guilty and without letting the other participants down.

**标签**：状语从句 / 被动语态 / 并列结构

## 生词

- variety/vəˈraɪəti/n.多样化；种类（a variety of 各种各样的）
- participant/pɑːrˈtɪsɪpənt/n.参与者；参加者
- organize/ˈɔːrɡənaɪz/vt.组织；安排
- guilty/ˈɡɪlti/adj.内疚的；有罪的
- let downv.使失望；辜负

## 主干

主干为「A variety of activities（主）+ should be organized（谓）」，so that 引导目的状语从句。

## 解析

- 主句 A variety of activities should be organized 为含情态动词的被动语态，a variety of 意为「各种各样的」。
- so that participants can remain active... and then go on to... 为 so that 引导的目的状语从句，从句内 remain 与 go on 为 can 连接的两个并列谓语。
- as long as they want 为 as long as 引导的条件状语从句，意为「只要他们愿意」，修饰 remain active，说明保持活跃的时间长度。
- without feeling guilty 与 without letting the other participants down 为并列的介词短语作状语，修饰 go on to something else，说明后续行为的方式。

## 翻译

应当组织各种各样的活动，让参与者想保持活跃多久就保持多久，然后再转而参与别的事情，既不感到内疚，也不让其他参与者失望。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Scientists need to respond forcefully to animal rights advocates, whos
entries.text:
## 原句

Scientists need to respond forcefully to animal rights advocates, whose arguments are confusing the public and thereby threatening advances in health knowledge and care.

**标签**：定语从句 / 并列结构

## 生词

- respond/rɪˈspɑːnd/vi.回答；作出反应（respond to）
- forcefully/ˈfɔːrsfəli/adv.有力地；坚决地
- advocate/ˈædvəkət/n.拥护者，提倡者（僻：作名词重音前移；作动词时意为「提倡」）
- confuse/kənˈfjuːz/vt.使困惑；混淆
- thereby/ˌðerˈbaɪ/adv.因此，从而
- threaten/ˈθretn/vt.威胁；危及
- advance/ədˈvæns/n.进步，进展（僻）

## 主干

主干为「Scientists（主）+ need to respond（谓）+ to animal rights advocates（对象）」，逗号后为 whose 引导的非限制性定语从句。

## 解析

- 主干：Scientists need to respond forcefully to animal rights advocates，need 后接不定式 to respond 作宾语，to animal rights advocates 说明回应的对象。
- whose arguments are confusing... and thereby threatening... 为 whose 引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰先行词 animal rights advocates，whose 在从句中作定语修饰 arguments。
- 从句谓语为现在进行时 are confusing 与 (are) threatening 的并列结构，thereby 为副词「从而」，引出前面行为所导致的结果。
- advances in health knowledge and care 中 in 引导的介词短语作后置定语，修饰 advances，意为「健康知识与医疗护理方面的进步」。

## 翻译

科学家需要对动物权利倡导者作出有力的回应，因为这些人的言论正在迷惑公众，进而威胁着健康知识与医疗护理领域的进步。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: To those who are unaware that animal research was needed to produce th
entries.text:
## 原句

To those who are unaware that animal research was needed to produce these treatments, as well as new treatments and vaccines, animal research seems wasteful at best and cruel at worst.

**标签**：定语从句 / 名词性从句 / 被动语态

## 生词

- unaware/ˌʌnəˈwer/adj.不知道的，未意识到的（be unaware that）
- treatment/ˈtriːtmənt/n.疗法，治疗；对待
- vaccine/vækˈsiːn/n.疫苗
- wasteful/ˈweɪstfl/adj.浪费的，挥霍的
- cruel/ˈkruːəl/adj.残酷的，残忍的

## 主干

主干为「animal research（主）+ seems（系）+ wasteful at best and cruel at worst（表）」，句首介词短语作状语。

## 解析

- To those who are unaware that... 为介词短语作状语，意为「对那些不知道……的人来说」，those 是对主语 animal research 作出评判的对象。
- who are unaware that... 为 who 引导的定语从句修饰 those；that 引导的从句作形容词 unaware 的补足语，说明「不知道」的具体内容，为名词性从句。
- 从句内部 animal research was needed to produce... 为被动语态；as well as new treatments and vaccines 为插入的并列成分，与 these treatments 同作 produce 的宾语。
- at best 与 at worst 为并列的介词短语作状语，分别搭配表语 wasteful 与 cruel，构成「往好处说……往坏处说……」的对照。

## 翻译

在那些不知道生产这些疗法以及新疗法和疫苗都离不开动物研究的人看来，动物研究往好里说是浪费，往坏里说就是残忍。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Finally, because the ultimate stakeholders are patients, the health re
entries.text:
## 原句

Finally, because the ultimate stakeholders are patients, the health research community should actively recruit to its cause not only well-known personalities such as Stephen Cooper, who has made courageous statements about the value of animal research, but all who receive medical treatment.

**标签**：状语从句 / 定语从句 / 分隔结构

## 生词

- ultimate/ˈʌltɪmət/adj.最终的；根本的
- stakeholder/ˈsteɪkhoʊldər/n.利益相关者；股东
- recruit/rɪˈkruːt/vt.招募，吸收（新成员）
- cause/kɔːz/n.事业（僻）；原因
- personality/ˌpɜːrsəˈnæləti/n.名人，名流（僻）；个性
- courageous/kəˈreɪdʒəs/adj.勇敢的，有胆量的

## 主干

主干为「the health research community（主）+ should actively recruit（谓）+ not only... but all...（并列宾语）」，because 从句提前表原因。

## 解析

- because the ultimate stakeholders are patients 为 because 引导的原因状语从句，置于句首说明主句招募行为的原因。
- 谓语 recruit 的宾语被状语 to its cause 分隔开，构成分隔结构；to its cause 意为「加入它的事业」，cause 为熟词僻义「事业」。
- not only... but (also)... 并列连接两个宾语：well-known personalities such as Stephen Cooper 与 all（后者接定语从句）。
- who has made courageous statements about... 为非限制性定语从句，修饰 Stephen Cooper；who receive medical treatment 为限制性定语从句，修饰 all。

## 翻译

最后，由于最终的利益相关者是病人，医疗研究界不仅应当积极争取斯蒂芬·库珀这样的知名人士投身其事业——他曾就动物研究的价值发表过勇敢的言论——而且应当争取所有接受医疗的病人。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: If railroads charged all customers the same average rate, they argue,
entries.text:
## 原句

If railroads charged all customers the same average rate, they argue, shippers who have the option of switching to trucks or other forms of transportation would do so, leaving remaining customers to shoulder the cost of keeping up the line.

**标签**：虚拟语气 / 定语从句 / 插入语

## 生词

- charge/tʃɑːrdʒ/vt.收费，索价；指控
- average/ˈævərɪdʒ/adj.平均的；普通的
- shipper/ˈʃɪpər/n.托运人，发货人
- option/ˈɑːpʃn/n.选择；选择权
- switch/swɪtʃ/v.转换，转变（switch to）
- transportation/ˌtrænspɔːrˈteɪʃn/n.运输；运输工具
- shoulder/ˈʃoʊldər/vt.承担，肩负（僻）

## 主干

主干为「shippers（主）+ would do so（谓）」，they argue 为插入语，句首 if 从句为假设条件。

## 解析

- they argue 为插入语，意为「他们认为」，把 if 条件从句与主句隔开，表明整个判断出自铁路公司之口。
- If railroads charged..., shippers would do so 为 if 引导的条件状语从句搭配 would 的虚拟语气，表示对现在情况的假设；从句内 charge sb. sth. 为双宾语结构。
- who have the option of switching to trucks or other forms of transportation 为定语从句修饰 shippers；of switching... 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 option。
- leaving remaining customers to shoulder the cost... 为现在分词短语作结果状语；shoulder 为熟词僻义，作动词「承担」；of keeping up the line 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 cost。

## 翻译

他们认为，如果铁路公司对所有客户都收取同样的平均费率，那么可以选择改用卡车或其他运输方式的托运人就会转投他处，而让剩下的客户来承担维持线路运营的成本。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: It’s a theory to which many economists subscribe, but in practice it o
entries.text:
## 原句

It’s a theory to which many economists subscribe, but in practice it often leaves railroads in the position of determining which companies will flourish and which will fail.

**标签**：定语从句 / 并列结构 / 名词性从句

## 生词

- theory/ˈθiːəri/n.理论；学说
- economist/ɪˈkɑːnəmɪst/n.经济学家
- subscribe/səbˈskraɪb/vi.订阅；同意，赞成（subscribe to，僻）
- determine/dɪˈtɜːrmɪn/vt.决定；确定
- flourish/ˈflɜːrɪʃ/vi.繁荣，兴旺；茁壮成长

## 主干

主干为 but 连接的并列句：「it’s a theory（前分句）+ it often leaves railroads in the position（后分句）」。

## 解析

- 本句为 but 连接的并列句，两个 it 均指上文的「公平」原则；前分句谈理论层面，后分句指出实际后果，构成对照。
- to which many economists subscribe 为「介词+which」引出的定语从句，修饰 theory；subscribe to 为熟词僻义「认同，赞成」。
- of determining which companies will flourish and which will fail 中，两个 which 引导的从句并列作 determining 的宾语，属名词性从句。
- in practice 为介词短语作状语插入，与 theory 形成「理论—实践」的对照。

## 翻译

这是一个许多经济学家都赞同的理论，但在实践中，它常常使铁路公司处于决定哪些公司兴旺、哪些公司倒闭的地位。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The emphasis on data gathered first-hand, combined with a cross-cultur
entries.text:
## 原句

The emphasis on data gathered first-hand, combined with a cross-cultural perspective brought to the analysis of cultures past and present, makes this study a unique and distinctly important social science.

**标签**：非谓语动词 / 分隔结构 / 并列结构

## 生词

- emphasis/ˈemfəsɪs/n.强调，重视（emphasis on）
- first-hand/ˌfɜːrst ˈhænd/adj.第一手的，直接的
- cross-cultural/ˌkrɔːs ˈkʌltʃərəl/adj.跨文化的
- perspective/pərˈspektɪv/n.视角，观点
- analysis/əˈnæləsɪs/n.分析
- distinctly/dɪˈstɪŋktli/adv.显然，无疑；独特地
- unique/juˈniːk/adj.独特的，独一无二的

## 主干

主干为「The emphasis（主）+ makes（谓）+ this study（宾）+ a unique and distinctly important social science（宾补）」。

## 解析

- 主干：The emphasis... makes this study a... social science，为「make+宾语+名词短语」结构，名词短语作宾补，意为「使这项研究成为一门……的社会科学」。
- on data gathered first-hand 中 on 介词短语作后置定语修饰 emphasis；gathered first-hand 为过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 data，意为「第一手收集的数据」。
- combined with a cross-cultural perspective brought to the analysis... 为过去分词短语作插入成分，补充说明主语，并把主语与谓语 makes 分隔，构成分隔结构；brought to... 亦为过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 perspective。
- of cultures past and present 修饰 analysis；past and present 为形容词后置修饰 cultures；and 连接 unique 与 distinctly important，共同修饰 social science。

## 翻译

对第一手资料的强调，再加上分析过去与现在的文化时所采用的跨文化视角，使这项研究成为一门独一无二、格外重要的社会科学。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Therefore, it is important to study humans in all their richness and d
entries.text:
## 原句

Therefore, it is important to study humans in all their richness and diversity in a calm and systematic manner, with the hope that the knowledge resulting from such studies can lead humans to a more harmonious way of living with themselves and with all other life forms on this planet Earth.（新增）

**标签**：同位语从句 / 非谓语动词 / 并列结构

## 生词

- systematic/ˌsɪstəˈmætɪk/adj.系统的；有条理的
- diversity/daɪˈvɜːrsəti/n.多样性；差异
- richness/ˈrɪtʃnəs/n.丰富，丰富性
- manner/ˈmænər/n.方式；举止
- harmonious/hɑːrˈmoʊniəs/adj.和谐的，融洽的
- planet/ˈplænɪt/n.行星；地球

## 主干

主干为「it（形式主语）+ is important（系表）+ to study humans（真正主语）」。

## 解析

- 本句为 it 作形式主语的句型：it is important to study humans...，真正主语是不定式短语；Therefore 为承接上文的连接副词。
- in all their richness and diversity 与 in a calm and systematic manner 为并列的介词短语作状语，修饰 study，分别说明研究对象的丰富多样与研究方式的冷静系统。
- with the hope that... 中 that 引导同位语从句，说明 hope 的具体内容，意为「怀着……的希望」。
- 同位语从句内，resulting from such studies 为现在分词短语作后置定语修饰 knowledge；lead humans to a more harmonious way of living 中，and 连接 with themselves 与 with all other life forms 两个并列成分，均修饰 living。

## 翻译

因此，以冷静而系统的方式研究人类自身的丰富性与多样性十分重要，我们希望由此类研究获得的知识能引导人类与自身、并与地球上的所有其他生命形式建立一种更加和谐的生活方式。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Ravitch’s latest book, Left Back: A Century of Failed School Reforms,
entries.text:
## 原句

Ravitch’s latest book, Left Back: A Century of Failed School Reforms, traces the roots of anti-intellectualism in our schools, concluding they are anything but a counterbalance to the American distaste for intellectual pursuits.

**标签**：非谓语动词 / 名词性从句 / 插入语

## 生词

- latest/ˈleɪtɪst/adj.最新的（late 的最高级）
- trace/treɪs/vt.追溯，探究……的根源；查出
- reform/rɪˈfɔːrm/n.改革，改良
- anti-intellectualism/ˌæntiˌɪntəˈlektʃuəlɪzəm/n.反智主义，反知识倾向
- counterbalance/ˈkaʊntərˌbæləns/n.制衡（因素），抵消物
- distaste/dɪsˈteɪst/n.厌恶，反感（distaste for）
- intellectual/ˌɪntəˈlektʃuəl/adj.智力的，知识的；n. 知识分子
- pursuit/pərˈsuːt/n.追求；爱好，消遣

## 主干

主干为「Ravitch’s latest book（主）+ traces（谓）+ the roots（宾）」，两处逗号之间为书名作同位语。

## 解析

- 主干：Ravitch’s latest book traces the roots of anti-intellectualism；Left Back: A Century of Failed School Reforms 为书名，作 latest book 的同位语，被两个逗号分隔。
- of anti-intellectualism 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 roots；in our schools 亦为后置定语修饰 anti-intellectualism，说明反智主义所在的场所。
- concluding they are anything but... 为现在分词短语作伴随状语，逻辑主语是这本书（的写作）；concluding 后接省略了引导词 that 的宾语从句。
- anything but 意为「绝不是」；a counterbalance to... 与 the American distaste for intellectual pursuits 中的 to、for 介词短语均为后置定语，分别说明制衡的对象与厌恶的对象。

## 翻译

拉维奇的新书《倒退：一个世纪失败的学校改革》追溯了我们学校中反智主义倾向的根源，并得出结论：我们的学校绝非对美国社会厌恶智力追求之风的一种制衡。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The Greeks assumed that the structure of language had some connection
entries.text:
## 原句

The Greeks assumed that the structure of language had some connection with the process of thought, which took root in Europe long before people realized how diverse languages could be.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 定语从句 / 状语从句

## 生词

- assume/əˈsuːm/vt.假定；认为
- structure/ˈstrʌktʃər/n.结构；构造
- connection/kəˈnekʃn/n.联系；关联
- process/ˈprɑːses/n.过程；进程
- diverse/dɪˈvɜːrs/adj.多种多样的；形形色色的

## 主干

主干为「The Greeks（主）+ assumed（谓）+ that 引导的宾语从句（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 The Greeks assumed that...，that 引导宾语从句，交代 assumed 的具体内容。
- 宾语从句内 the structure of language 与 the process of thought 由 of 短语分别修饰，意为“语言结构与思维过程”。
- which took root in Europe 为非限定性定语从句，which 指代前面整个主句的观点，即“语言与思维相关”这一假定。
- long before 引导时间状语从句，其中 how diverse languages could be 作 realized 的宾语从句，how 修饰 diverse。

## 翻译

希腊人认为，语言结构与思维过程之间存在着某种联系，这一观点早在人们认识到语言是多么千差万别之前，就已扎根欧洲。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: However, when two monkeys were placed in separate but adjoining chambe
entries.text:
## 原句
