However, when two monkeys were placed in separate but adjoining chambers, so that each could observe what the other was getting in return for its rock, their behaviour became markedly different.

**标签**：状语从句 / 被动语态 / 名词性从句

## 生词

- separate/ˈseprət/adj.分开的；独立的
- adjoining/əˈdʒɔɪnɪŋ/adj.毗邻的；相邻的
- chamber/ˈtʃeɪmbər/n.房间；腔室
- observe/əbˈzɜːrv/vt.观察；看到
- markedly/ˈmɑːrkɪdli/adv.显著地；明显地

## 主干

主干为「their behaviour（主）+ became（系）+ markedly different（表）」，前面为两层状语从句。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 their behaviour became markedly different，主系表结构，前面是两个状语从句。
- when two monkeys were placed in separate but adjoining chambers 为时间状语从句，were placed 为被动语态，separate but adjoining 为并列形容词修饰 chambers。
- so that each could observe... 为目的状语从句，其中 what the other was getting 作 observe 的宾语从句。
- in return for its rock 为介词短语作状语，意为“以石头作为交换”。

## 翻译

然而，当两只猴子被安置在两个独立但相邻的房间里，以便每只猴子都能观察到对方用石头换到了什么时，它们的行为就变得明显不同了。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: And if one received a grape without having to provide her token in exc
entries.text:
## 原句

And if one received a grape without having to provide her token in exchange at all, the other either tossed her own token at the researcher or out of the chamber, or refused to accept the slice of cucumber.

**标签**：状语从句 / 并列结构 / 非谓语动词

## 生词

- token/ˈtoʊkən/n.代币；筹码
- grape/ɡreɪp/n.葡萄
- toss/tɔːs/vt.扔；抛；掷
- slice/slaɪs/n.薄片；一片
- cucumber/ˈkjuːkʌmbər/n.黄瓜

## 主干

主干为「the other（主）+ either tossed... or refused（either...or 并列谓语）+ the token / the slice of cucumber（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 the other either tossed... or refused...，either...or 再加一个 or 连接三个并列谓语。
- if one received a grape 为条件状语从句；without having to provide her token in exchange 为介词短语作状语，having 为动名词。
- tossed her own token at the researcher or out of the chamber 中，at the researcher 与 out of the chamber 并列作状语，or 后省略了 tossed her own token。
- refuse to accept 为固定搭配，意为“拒绝接受”；the slice of cucumber 指那一小片黄瓜。

## 翻译

而且，如果一只猴子完全不必交出代币就能得到一颗葡萄，那么另一只猴子要么把自己的代币扔向研究人员或扔出房间，要么拒绝接受那片黄瓜。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: However, whether such a sense of fairness evolved independently in cap
entries.text:
## 原句

However, whether such a sense of fairness evolved independently in capuchins and humans, or whether it stems from the common ancestor that the species had 35 million years ago, is, as yet, an unanswered question.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 定语从句 / 分隔结构

## 生词

- fairness/ˈfernəs/n.公平；公正
- evolve/ɪˈvɑːlv/v.进化；逐渐发展
- stem/stem/vi.（stem from）起源于；（僻）遏制
- ancestor/ˈænsestər/n.祖先；先辈
- capuchin/ˈkæpjəwɪn/n.卷尾猴
- species/ˈspiːʃiːz/n.物种；种类

## 主干

主干为「whether...or whether...（两个并列主语从句作主语）+ is（系）+ an unanswered question（表）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 whether...or whether... is an unanswered question：两个 whether 引导的主语从句并列作主语。
- 第一个从句中 such a sense of fairness 为主语，evolved 为谓语，independently 与 in capuchins and humans 分别为方式、地点状语。
- 第二个从句中 that the species had 35 million years ago 为定语从句，引导词 that 修饰先行词 the common ancestor。
- as yet 为插入语，意为“迄今为止”，把长主语与系动词 is 隔开，形成分隔结构。

## 翻译

然而，这种公平感究竟是在卷尾猴和人类身上独立进化而来的，还是源于二者 3500 万年前共同的祖先，迄今为止仍是一个没有答案的问题。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: But science does provide us with the best available guide to the futur
entries.text:
## 原句

But science does provide us with the best available guide to the future, and it is critical that our nation and the world base important policies on the best judgments that science can provide concerning the future consequences of present actions.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 定语从句 / 虚拟语气

## 生词

- available/əˈveɪləbl/adj.可获得的；可利用的
- guide/ɡaɪd/n.指南；指导
- critical/ˈkrɪtɪkl/adj.至关重要的；批判性的
- base/beɪs/vt.以…为基础（base...on）
- judgment/ˈdʒʌdʒmənt/n.判断；判断力
- consequence/ˈkɑːnsəkwens/n.后果；结果

## 主干

主干为「science（主）+ does provide（谓）+ guide（宾）」and「it（形式主语）+ is critical（系表）+ that 从句（真正主语）」。

## 解析

- 本句由 and 连接两个并列分句：science does provide us with... 与 it is critical that...。
- 第一分句中 does 为助动词，强调谓语 provide；to the future 为介词短语作 guide 的后置定语。
- 第二分句 it 为形式主语，that 引导的主语从句为真正主语；critical 后从句谓语用动词原形 base，属虚拟语气。
- that science can provide 为定语从句修饰 judgments；concerning...为介词短语（相当于 about）作后置定语，亦修饰 judgments。

## 翻译

但是，科学的确为我们提供了关于未来的最佳指南，至关重要的一点是：我们的国家和整个世界在制定重大政策时，应以科学就当前行动的未来后果所能作出的最佳判断为依据。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Television is one of the means by which these feelings are created and
entries.text:
## 原句

Television is one of the means by which these feelings are created and conveyed—and perhaps never before has it served so much to connect different peoples and nations as in the recent events in Europe.

**标签**：定语从句 / 倒装 / 比较结构

## 生词

- means/miːnz/n.手段；方式
- convey/kənˈveɪ/vt.传递；表达；运送
- create/kriˈeɪt/vt.创造；引起，激发
- serve/sɜːrv/v.服务；（serve to do）起…作用
- people/ˈpiːpl/n.（复数 peoples）民族（僻）；人们

## 主干

主干为「Television（主）+ is（系）+ one of the means（表）」；破折号后为「it（主）+ has served（谓）」的倒装分句。

## 解析

- 破折号前主干为 Television is one of the means，主系表结构；破折号后为并列分句，作进一步递进说明。
- by which these feelings are created and conveyed 为介词 + which 引导的定语从句修饰 means，从句为被动语态，created 与 conveyed 并列。
- never before 为否定意义的副词置于句首，引起部分倒装，助动词 has 提至主语 it 之前。
- never...so much...as... 为比较结构，as in the recent events in Europe 点明比较对象，即与近来欧洲的事件相比。

## 翻译

电视是创造并传递这些感受的手段之一——在联系不同民族和国家方面，它此前或许从未像在近来欧洲的事件中那样发挥过如此巨大的作用。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: People are absorbed into “a culture of consumption” launched by the 19
entries.text:
## 原句

People are absorbed into “a culture of consumption” launched by the 19th-century department stores that offered “vast arrays of goods in an elegant atmosphere.

**标签**：被动语态 / 非谓语动词 / 定语从句

## 生词

- absorb/əbˈzɔːrb/vt.吸收；使并入，使卷入
- consumption/kənˈsʌmpʃn/n.消费；消耗
- launch/lɔːntʃ/vt.发起；开创；发射
- array/əˈreɪ/n.大量；一系列（an array of）
- elegant/ˈelɪɡənt/adj.优雅的；精致的
- atmosphere/ˈætməsfɪr/n.气氛，氛围；大气

## 主干

主干为「People（主）+ are absorbed into（谓，被动）+ a culture of consumption（介词宾语）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 People are absorbed into “a culture of consumption”，其中 are absorbed into 为被动语态。
- launched by the 19th-century department stores 为过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 a culture of consumption，含被动意味。
- that offered “vast arrays of goods in an elegant atmosphere 为定语从句，引导词 that 修饰先行词 department stores。
- vast arrays of goods 意为“大量琳琅满目的商品”；in an elegant atmosphere 在从句中作地点状语。

## 翻译

人们被卷入一种“消费文化”之中，这种文化是由 19 世纪的百货商店开创的，这些商店在优雅的氛围中供应琳琅满目的商品。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Rodriguez notes that children in remote villages around the world are
entries.text:
## 原句

Rodriguez notes that children in remote villages around the world are fans of superstars like Arnold Schwarzenegger and Garth Brooks, yet “some Americans fear that immigrants living within the United States remain somehow immune to the nation’s assimilative power.”

**标签**：名词性从句 / 并列结构 / 非谓语动词

## 生词

- note/noʊt/vt.指出；注意到（僻）
- remote/rɪˈmoʊt/adj.遥远的；偏远的
- immigrant/ˈɪmɪɡrənt/n.移民；侨民
- somehow/ˈsʌmhaʊ/adv.不知怎么地；以某种方式
- immune/ɪˈmjuːn/adj.免疫的；不受…影响的
- assimilative/əˈsɪmələtɪv/adj.同化的

## 主干

主干为「Rodriguez（主）+ notes（谓）+ that 宾语从句」，yet 连接「some Americans（主）+ fear（谓）+ that 宾语从句」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 Rodriguez notes that...，yet 连接两个转折并列的分句，第二分句为直接引语。
- 第一个 that 宾语从句中，in remote villages around the world 作后置定语修饰 children；like Arnold Schwarzenegger and Garth Brooks 举例修饰 superstars。
- 第二分句中 fear 后接 that 引导的宾语从句；living within the United States 为现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰 immigrants。
- remain 在从句中作系动词，immune to... 意为“对…免疫、不受…影响”；somehow 意为“不知为何”。

## 翻译

罗德里格斯指出，世界各地偏远村庄里的孩子都是阿诺德·施瓦辛格和加思·布鲁克斯这类超级巨星的粉丝；然而“一些美国人却担心，居住在美国境内的移民不知为何仍不受这个国家同化力的影响”。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: The rise of anti-happy art almost exactly tracks the emergence of mass
entries.text:
## 原句

The rise of anti-happy art almost exactly tracks the emergence of mass media, and with it, a commercial culture in which happiness is not just an ideal but an ideology.

**标签**：并列结构 / 插入语 / 定语从句

## 生词

- anti-happy/ˌænti ˈhæpi/adj.反快乐的
- track/træk/vt.追踪；与…同步发展（僻）
- emergence/ɪˈmɜːrdʒəns/n.出现；兴起
- mass/mæs/adj.大众的；大批的
- commercial/kəˈmɜːrʃl/adj.商业的；营利的
- ideal/aɪˈdiːəl/n.理想
- ideology/ˌaɪdiˈɑːlədʒi/n.意识形态；思想体系

## 主干

主干为「The rise（主）+ tracks（谓）+ the emergence...and a commercial culture（并列宾语）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 The rise of anti-happy art tracks the emergence of mass media；and 连接第二个并列宾语 a commercial culture，其前省略了谓语 tracks。
- with it 为插入语，it 回指 the emergence of mass media，意为“随之、伴随而来”。
- in which happiness is not just an ideal but an ideology 为介词 + which 引导的定语从句，修饰 a commercial culture。
- not just...but... 为并列结构，意为“不仅是…而且是…”，强调快乐在商业文化中的地位变化。

## 翻译

反快乐艺术的兴起几乎与大众传媒的出现完全同步，随之而来的还有一种商业文化，在这种文化中，快乐不仅仅是一种理想，更是一种意识形态。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: In the West, before mass communication and literacy, the most powerful
entries.text:
## 原句

In the West, before mass communication and literacy, the most powerful mass medium was the church, which reminded worshippers that their souls were in danger and that they would someday be meat for worms.

**标签**：定语从句 / 名词性从句 / 并列结构

## 生词

- literacy/ˈlɪtərəsi/n.识字；读写能力
- medium/ˈmiːdiəm/n.媒介；手段（复数 media）
- worshipper/ˈwɜːrʃɪpər/n.礼拜者；崇拜者
- soul/soʊl/n.灵魂；心灵
- mass/mæs/adj.大众的；大批的

## 主干

主干为「the most powerful mass medium（主）+ was（系）+ the church（表）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干为 the most powerful mass medium was the church，主系表结构；In the West 与 before mass communication and literacy 分别为地点、时间状语。
- which reminded worshippers that... and that... 为非限定性定语从句，修饰 the church。
- 两个 that 引导的宾语从句由 and 并列，共同作 reminded 的宾语，构成 remind sb. that... 结构。
- would someday be meat for worms 中 would 表过去将来，meat for worms 为隐喻，指人终有一死、化为蛆虫之食。

## 翻译

在西方，在大众传播和识字普及之前，最强大有力的大众媒介是教堂，它提醒礼拜者：他们的灵魂正处于危险之中，终有一天会成为蛆虫的食物。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: His function is analogous to that of a judge, who must accept the obli
entries.text:
## 原句

His function is analogous to that of a judge, who must accept the obligation of revealing in as obvious a manner as possible the course of reasoning which led him to his decision.

**标签**：定语从句 / 分隔结构 / 比较结构

## 生词

- analogous/əˈnæləɡəs/adj.类似的；可比拟的
- obligation/ˌɑːblɪˈɡeɪʃn/n.义务；职责
- reveal/rɪˈviːl/vt.揭示；透露
- obvious/ˈɑːbviəs/adj.明显的；清楚的
- manner/ˈmænər/n.方式；方法
- reasoning/ˈriːznɪŋ/n.推理；论证

## 主干

主干为「His function（主）+ is（系）+ analogous（表）」，that of a judge 中的 that 指代 function。

## 解析

- 本句主干：His function is analogous to that of a judge，that 指代前文的 function，analogous to 意为“与……类似”。
- who must accept the obligation... 为 who 引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰先行词 a judge，说明法官须承担的义务。
- of revealing the course of reasoning 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 obligation；revealing 的宾语因方式状语较长而与动名词分隔，属动宾分隔。
- in as obvious a manner as possible 为方式状语，采用“as + 形容词 + a/an + 名词 + as possible”的比较结构。
- which led him to his decision 为 which 引导的定语从句，修饰先行词 the course of reasoning。

## 翻译

他的职责与法官的职责类似——法官必须承担起这样的义务：以尽可能明了的方式，揭示使其作出裁决的推理过程。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Born in the crisis of the old regime and Iberian colonialism, many of
entries.text:
## 原句

Born in the crisis of the old regime and Iberian colonialism, many of the leaders of independence share the ideals of representative government, careers open to talent, freedom of commerce and trade, the right to private property, and a belief in the individual as the basis of society.

**标签**：非谓语动词 / 并列结构

## 生词

- regime/reɪˈʒiːm/n.政权；政体
- colonialism/kəˈloʊniəlɪzəm/n.殖民主义
- representative/ˌreprɪˈzentətɪv/adj.代议制的；有代表性的
- commerce/ˈkɑːmɜːrs/n.商业；贸易
- property/ˈprɑːpərti/n.财产；房产
- ideal/aɪˈdiːəl/n.理想；完美典型

## 主干

主干为「many of the leaders of independence（主）+ share（谓）+ the ideals（宾）」，其后接由单个 of 引出的五个并列名词短语（作 ideals 的同位性解释）。

## 解析

- 本句主干：many of the leaders of independence share the ideals...，谓语 share 后的宾语为长并列结构。
- Born in the crisis of the old regime and Iberian colonialism 为过去分词短语作状语，置于句首交代主语 many of the leaders 的出身背景。
- of representative government, careers open to talent, freedom of commerce and trade, the right to private property, and a belief... 为五个并列的 of 介词短语，共同修饰 ideals。
- open to talent 为形容词短语作后置定语，修饰 careers，意为“向有才能者开放的职业”。
- as the basis of society 与 a belief in the individual 连用，说明“个人是社会基础”这一信念的内容。

## 翻译

许多独立运动领袖出生于旧政权和伊比利亚殖民主义统治的危机之中，他们共同怀有这些理想：代议制政府、人尽其才的职业、商贸自由、私有财产权，以及个人是社会基础的信念。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: In other words, whatever inborn differences two people may exhibit in
entries.text:
## 原句

In other words, whatever inborn differences two people may exhibit in their abilities to memorize, those differences are swamped by how well each person “encodes” the information.

**标签**：状语从句 / 名词性从句 / 被动语态

## 生词

- inborn/ˌɪnˈbɔːrn/adj.天生的；先天的
- exhibit/ɪɡˈzɪbɪt/vt.表现出；展示
- memorize/ˈmeməraɪz/vt.记忆；熟记
- swamp/swɑːmp/vt.（僻）淹没；使不堪应对 n. 沼泽
- encode/ɪnˈkoʊd/vt.编码；把……译成电码

## 主干

主干为「those differences（主）+ are swamped by（谓，被动）+ how well each person “encodes” the information（介词宾语从句）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：those differences are swamped by...，为被动语态，介词 by 后接 how 引导的宾语从句。
- whatever inborn differences two people may exhibit... 为 whatever 引导的让步状语从句，differences 是 exhibit 的宾语，故被提到 exhibit 之前。
- in their abilities to memorize 为介词短语作状语，其中 to memorize 为不定式作后置定语修饰 abilities。
- how well each person “encodes” the information 为 how 引导的名词性从句，作介词 by 的宾语，说明差异被掩盖的原因。

## 翻译

换句话说，无论两个人在记忆能力上表现出怎样的先天差异，这些差异都会被各人对信息进行“编码”的优劣程度所掩盖。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: During the past generation, the American middle-class family that once
entries.text:
## 原句

During the past generation, the American middle-class family that once could count on hard work and fair play to keep itself financially secure has been transformed by economic risk and new realities.

**标签**：定语从句 / 被动语态

## 生词

- generation/ˌdʒenəˈreɪʃn/n.一代人；一代
- secure/sɪˈkjʊr/adj.安稳的；有保障的 vt. 获得
- transform/trænsˈfɔːrm/vt.使改观；使转变
- financially/faɪˈnænʃəli/adv.财务上；经济上
- fair/fer/adj.公平的；公正的

## 主干

主干为「the American middle-class family（主）+ has been transformed（谓，被动）+ by economic risk and new realities（状）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：the American middle-class family has been transformed by economic risk and new realities，为现在完成时的被动语态。
- that once could count on hard work and fair play to keep itself financially secure 为 that 引导的定语从句，修饰 family，count on 意为“依靠”。
- to keep itself financially secure 为不定式作目的状语，采用“keep + 宾语 + 形容词”的复合宾语结构，itself 指 family。
- During the past generation 为时间状语，置于句首，与谓语的现在完成时相呼应。

## 翻译

在过去二三十年间，原本可以依靠勤奋工作和公平竞争来维持经济安稳的美国中产阶级家庭，已被经济风险和种种新的现实所改变。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Now a pink slip, a bad diagnosis, or a disappearing spouse can reduce
entries.text:
## 原句

Now a pink slip, a bad diagnosis, or a disappearing spouse can reduce a family from solidly middle class to newly poor in a few months.

**标签**：并列结构

## 生词

- slip/slɪp/n.（僻）小纸条；差错 vi. 滑落
- diagnosis/ˌdaɪəɡˈnoʊsɪs/n.诊断；诊断结论
- spouse/spaʊs/n.配偶
- solidly/ˈsɑːlɪdli/adv.稳固地；牢靠地
- reduce/rɪˈduːs/vt.使陷入（某种境地）；减少

## 主干

主干为「a pink slip, a bad diagnosis, or a disappearing spouse（并列主语）+ can reduce（谓）+ a family（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：a pink slip, a bad diagnosis, or a disappearing spouse can reduce a family...，三个并列的名词短语作主语，由 or 连接。
- reduce...from...to... 为固定搭配，from solidly middle class 与 to newly poor 分别点明家庭境况变化的起点与终点。
- in a few months 为时间状语，强调跌落之迅速；副词 solidly 与 newly 分别修饰 middle class 和 poor，形成前后对照。

## 翻译

如今，一纸解雇通知书、一个糟糕的诊断结果，或配偶的离世，都可能在几个月内使一个家庭从殷实的中产阶级跌落为新增的贫困家庭。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: As a result, they have lost the parachute they once had in times of fi
entries.text:
## 原句

As a result, they have lost the parachute they once had in times of financial setback—a back-up earner (usually Mom) who could go into the workforce if the primary earner got laid off or fell sick.

**标签**：定语从句 / 状语从句 / 省略

## 生词

- parachute/ˌpærəˈʃuːt/n.降落伞；（喻）保障
- setback/ˈsetbæk/n.挫折；倒退
- earner/ˈɜːrnər/n.挣钱者；挣工资的人
- workforce/ˈwɜːrkfɔːrs/n.劳动力；劳动人口
- primary/ˈpraɪmeri/adj.主要的；首要的

## 主干

主干为「they（主）+ have lost（谓）+ the parachute（宾）」，破折号后为其同位语。

## 解析

- 本句主干：they have lost the parachute，As a result 承接上文，表示结果。
- (that) they once had in times of financial setback 为省略引导词 that 的定语从句，修饰 the parachute。
- 破折号后 a back-up earner (usually Mom) 为 the parachute 的同位语，具体解释“降落伞”的含义，(usually Mom) 为插入成分。
- who could go into the workforce... 为 who 引导的定语从句修饰 earner，其中嵌套 if 引导的条件状语从句，got laid off 与 fell sick 为并列谓语。

## 翻译

因此，他们失去了过去经济困难时期所拥有的“降落伞”——一位后备挣钱者（通常是母亲），她可以在主要挣钱者失业或生病时出去工作。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Steelworkers, airline employees, and now those in the auto industry ar
entries.text:
## 原句

Steelworkers, airline employees, and now those in the auto industry are joining millions of families who must worry about interest rates, stock market fluctuation, and the harsh reality that they may outlive their retirement money.

**标签**：定语从句 / 同位语从句 / 并列结构

## 生词

- auto/ˈɔːtoʊ/n.汽车（automobile 的缩略）
- fluctuation/ˌflʌktʃuˈeɪʃn/n.波动；起伏
- harsh/hɑːrʃ/adj.严酷的；刺耳的
- outlive/ˌaʊtˈlɪv/vt.比……存在得久；安然度过
- retirement/rɪˈtaɪərmənt/n.退休；退休生活

## 主干

主干为「Steelworkers, airline employees, and those in the auto industry（并列主语）+ are joining（谓）+ millions of families（宾）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：Steelworkers, airline employees, and those in the auto industry are joining millions of families，三个并列名词短语作主语。
- who must worry about interest rates, stock market fluctuation, and the harsh reality... 为 who 引导的定语从句，修饰 millions of families，worry about 后接三个并列宾语。
- that they may outlive their retirement money 为 that 引导的同位语从句，解释说明 the harsh reality 的具体内容。
- outlive 属熟词僻义，“比……存在得久”，此处指人还健在而退休金已用尽。

## 翻译

钢铁工人、航空公司雇员，以及如今汽车行业的从业者，正在加入数百万家庭的行列——这些家庭必须为利率、股市波动，以及“退休金可能不够终老”这一严酷现实而忧心。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: From the middle-class family perspective, much of this, understandably
entries.text:
## 原句

From the middle-class family perspective, much of this, understandably, looks far less like an opportunity to exercise more financial responsibility, and a good deal more like a frightening acceleration of the wholesale shift of financial risk onto their already overburdened shoulders.

**标签**：比较结构 / 插入语

## 生词

- perspective/pərˈspektɪv/n.视角；观点
- understandably/ˌʌndərˈstændəbli/adv.可以理解地；难怪
- exercise/ˈeksərsaɪz/vt.（僻）行使；运用 n. 锻炼
- acceleration/əkˌseləˈreɪʃn/n.加速；加快
- wholesale/ˈhoʊlseɪl/adj.大规模的；批发的
- overburdened/ˌoʊvərˈbɜːrdnd/adj.不堪重负的；负担过重的

## 主干

主干为「much of this（主）+ looks（系）+ far less like an opportunity... and a good deal more like a frightening acceleration（表，比较结构）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：much of this looks far less like an opportunity... and a good deal more like a frightening acceleration...，为 less...more... 的比较结构。
- From the middle-class family perspective 为介词短语作状语；understandably 为插入的评注性副词，意为“可以理解地”。
- to exercise more financial responsibility 为不定式作后置定语，修饰 opportunity；exercise 为熟词僻义，“行使、履行”。
- of the wholesale shift of financial risk onto their already overburdened shoulders 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 acceleration，shift...onto... 意为“把……转嫁到……”。

## 翻译

而从中产阶级家庭的视角来看，可以理解的是，这一切与其说像一个行使更多财务责任的机会，不如说更像是一场令人惊恐的加速——财务风险正被大规模地转嫁到他们本已不堪重负的肩上。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Surely it should be obvious to the dimmest executive that trust, that
entries.text:
## 原句

Surely it should be obvious to the dimmest executive that trust, that most valuable of economic assets, is easily destroyed and hugely expensive to restore—and that few things are more likely to destroy trust than a company letting sensitive personal data get into the wrong hands.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 并列结构 / 比较结构

## 生词

- dim/dɪm/adj.迟钝的；昏暗的
- executive/ɪɡˈzekjətɪv/n.主管；行政人员
- asset/ˈæset/n.资产；有价值的人或物
- restore/rɪˈstɔːr/vt.恢复；修复
- sensitive/ˈsenətɪv/adj.敏感的；须保密的

## 主干

主干为「it（形式主语）+ should be obvious（系表）+ that... and that...（and 连接的两个并列主语从句）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：it should be obvious to the dimmest executive that...，it 为形式主语，真正主语是 and 连接的两个 that 引导的并列主语从句。
- 第一个 that 从句中，that most valuable of economic assets 为插入的同位语，说明 trust，属“最高级 + of + 名词”的名词化结构，意为“经济资产中最宝贵者”。
- is easily destroyed and hugely expensive to restore 为并列表语，前者为被动语态，后者为“be + 形容词 + 不定式”结构。
- 第二个 that 从句中，few things are more likely to destroy trust than... 以否定词加比较级表达最高级含义；letting... 为动名词短语作比较对象，get 前省略 to 作宾补。

## 翻译

想必连最迟钝的管理者也应当明白：信任是最宝贵的经济资产之一，它极易被摧毁，而恢复起来代价极其高昂——而且，几乎没有比公司让敏感的个人数据落入不当之人之手更容易摧毁信任的事了。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Just as bosses and boards have finally sorted out their worst accounti
entries.text:
## 原句

Just as bosses and boards have finally sorted out their worst accounting and compliance troubles, and improved their feeble corporation governance, a new problem threatens to earn them—especially in America—the sort of nasty headlines that inevitably lead to heads rolling in the executive suite: data insecurity.

**标签**：状语从句 / 定语从句 / 插入语

## 生词

- board/bɔːrd/n.（僻）董事会；委员会；木板
- compliance/kəmˈplaɪəns/n.合规；遵守
- feeble/ˈfiːbl/adj.软弱无力的；低效的
- governance/ˈɡʌvərnəns/n.治理；管理
- nasty/ˈnæsti/adj.糟糕的；严重的；难缠的
- inevitably/ɪnˈevɪtəbli/adv.不可避免地；必然地

## 主干

主干为「a new problem（主）+ threatens（谓）+ to earn them... headlines（不定式宾语）」，冒号后的 data insecurity 补充说明主语。

## 解析

- 本句主干：a new problem threatens to earn them the sort of nasty headlines...，冒号后的 data insecurity 点明 a new problem 的具体内容。
- Just as bosses and boards have finally sorted out... and improved... 为 just as 引导的状语从句，从句内含 sorted out 与 improved 两个并列谓语。
- 双破折号之间的 especially in America 为插入语，起地点范围上的强调限定作用。
- that inevitably lead to heads rolling in the executive suite 为 that 引导的定语从句，修饰 headlines；heads rolling 为“名词 + 现在分词”的复合结构，喻指高管层人员被解职。

## 翻译

就在老板们和董事会终于解决了最严重的账目和合规问题、改善了原本疲弱的公司治理之际，一个新的问题又可能给他们——尤其是在美国——招致那种必然导致高管层“人头落地”的难堪头条新闻：数据不安全。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Traditionally, legal learning has been viewed in such institutions as
entries.text:
## 原句

Traditionally, legal learning has been viewed in such institutions as the special preserve of lawyers, rather than a necessary part of the intellectual equipment of an educated person.

**标签**：被动语态 / 分隔结构 / 并列结构

## 生词

- legal/ˈliːɡl/adj.法律的；合法的
- institution/ˌɪnstɪˈtuːʃn/n.机构；制度
- preserve/prɪˈzɜːrv/n.（僻）专属领域，独占范围；v. 保存，保护
- intellectual/ˌɪntəˈlektʃuəl/adj.智力的；知识的
- equipment/ɪˈkwɪpmənt/n.装备；（僻）知识素养，才能配备

## 主干

主干为「legal learning（主）+ has been viewed as（谓，被动）+ the special preserve（主语补足语）」，rather than 引出与之并列的另一说法。

## 解析

- 本句主干：legal learning has been viewed as the special preserve of lawyers，为被动语态，view...as 意为「把……视为」。
- in such institutions 为介词短语作状语，被插在 viewed 与 as 之间，把谓语和补足语隔开，形成分隔结构。
- rather than a necessary part... 与 the special preserve 并列，共用 viewed as，rather than 之后省略了 viewed as。
- of the intellectual equipment of an educated person 为介词短语作后置定语，逐层修饰 part。

## 翻译

传统上，在这类院校中，法律学习一直被视为律师的专属领域，而不是受过教育者知识素养的必要组成部分。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: On the other, it links these concepts to everyday realities in a manne
entries.text:
## 原句

On the other, it links these concepts to everyday realities in a manner which is parallel to the links journalists forge on a daily basis as they cover and comment on the news.

**标签**：定语从句 / 状语从句 / 省略

## 生词

- concept/ˈkɑːnsept/n.概念，观念
- parallel/ˈpærəlel/adj.类似的，相应的；平行的
- forge/fɔːrdʒ/v.缔造，建立（联系）；锻造
- cover/ˈkʌvər/v.（僻）报道；覆盖
- comment/kəˈment/v.评论（comment on）

## 主干

主干为「it（主）+ links（谓）+ these concepts（宾）+ to everyday realities」，in a manner 为方式状语。

## 解析

- 本句主干：it links these concepts to everyday realities，意为「它把这些概念与日常现实联系起来」；On the other 承接上文的 On the one hand。
- in a manner 为介词短语作方式状语；which is parallel to the links 为定语从句，引导词 which 指代先行词 manner。
- journalists forge on a daily basis 为省略引导词 that 的定语从句，修饰 links，从句内 journalists 作主语、forge 作谓语。
- as they cover and comment on the news 为 as 引导的时间状语从句，修饰 forge；cover 此处是熟词僻义「报道」。

## 翻译

另一方面，它把这些概念与日常现实联系起来，其方式类似于新闻记者每天在报道、评论新闻时所建立的那种联系。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Studies of both animals and humans have shown that sex hormones someho
entries.text:
## 原句

Studies of both animals and humans have shown that sex hormones somehow affect the stress response, causing females under stress to produce more of the trigger chemicals than do males under the same conditions.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 非谓语动词 / 倒装

## 生词

- hormone/ˈhɔːrmoʊn/n.激素，荷尔蒙
- somehow/ˈsʌmhaʊ/adv.以某种方式；不知怎么地
- affect/əˈfekt/v.影响
- response/rɪˈspɑːns/n.反应，响应
- trigger/ˈtrɪɡər/v.引发，触发
- chemical/ˈkemɪkl/n.化学物质

## 主干

主干为「Studies（主）+ have shown（谓）+ that 引导的宾语从句」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：Studies...have shown that...，that 引导宾语从句作 shown 的宾语；主语后 of both animals and humans 作后置定语。
- 宾语从句内主干为 sex hormones affect the stress response，somehow 作状语，意为「以某种方式」。
- causing females...to produce... 为现在分词短语作结果状语，逻辑主语是前面整个从句所述内容。
- than do males under the same conditions 为比较状语从句，助动词 do 提到主语 males 之前构成部分倒装，以避免头重脚轻。

## 翻译

对动物和人类的研究都已表明，性激素会以某种方式影响压力反应，使得处于压力下的女性比同等条件下的男性分泌出更多的触发性化学物质。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Moreover, even though humans have been upright for millions of years,
entries.text:
## 原句

Moreover, even though humans have been upright for millions of years, our feet and back continue to struggle with bipedal posture and cannot easily withstand repeated strain imposed by oversize limbs.

**标签**：状语从句 / 并列结构 / 非谓语动词

## 生词

- upright/ˈʌpraɪt/adj.直立的；垂直的
- bipedal/baɪˈpiːdl/adj.两足行走的
- posture/ˈpɑːstʃər/n.姿势，体态
- withstand/wɪðˈstænd/v.承受，经受住
- strain/streɪn/n.劳损；压力；张力
- impose/ɪmˈpoʊz/v.施加（impose...on）
- oversize/ˈoʊvərsaɪz/adj.过大的，超大型的
- limb/lɪm/n.肢，臂，腿

## 主干

主干为「our feet and back（主）+ continue to struggle with... and cannot easily withstand...（and 连接的两个并列谓语）」。

## 解析

- 本句主干：our feet and back continue to struggle with bipedal posture and cannot easily withstand repeated strain，and 连接两个并列谓语。
- even though humans have been upright for millions of years 为 even though 引导的让步状语从句，位于句首。
- Moreover 为句首副词，表递进，承接上文对人类身体结构缺陷的论述。
- imposed by oversize limbs 为过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 strain，含被动意义，即「由过大的肢体反复施加的」。

## 翻译

此外，尽管人类直立行走已有数百万年，我们的双脚和背部却仍在与两足行走的姿势艰难抗衡，难以轻松承受过大肢体反复造成的劳损。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Washington, who had begun to believe that all men were created equal a
entries.text:
## 原句

Washington, who had begun to believe that all men were created equal after observing the bravery of the black soldiers during the Revolutionary War, overcame the strong opposition of his relatives to grant his slaves their freedom in his will.

**标签**：定语从句 / 名词性从句 / 非谓语动词

## 生词

- observe/əbˈzɜːrv/v.观察；目睹
- bravery/ˈbreɪvəri/n.勇敢，英勇
- revolutionary/ˌrevəˈluːʃəneri/adj.革命的（the Revolutionary War 指美国独立战争）
- opposition/ˌɑːpəˈzɪʃn/n.反对；反对派
- grant/ɡrænt/v.授予，给予
- will/wɪl/n.（僻）遗嘱；意志

## 主干

主干为「Washington（主）+ overcame（谓）+ the strong opposition（宾）」，不定式 to grant... 作目的状语。

## 解析

- 本句主干：Washington overcame the strong opposition of his relatives，意为「华盛顿顶住了亲属们的强烈反对」。
- who had begun to believe... 为非限制性定语从句修饰 Washington，插入主语与谓语之间，造成主谓分隔。
- that all men were created equal 为 that 引导的宾语从句作 believe 的宾语，从句内为被动语态；after observing... 为介词+动名词作时间状语。
- to grant his slaves their freedom in his will 为不定式短语作目的状语；grant sb. sth. 为双宾语结构，will 此处是熟词僻义「遗嘱」。

## 翻译

在目睹黑人士兵于独立战争中的英勇表现之后，华盛顿开始相信人人生而平等；他顶住了亲属的强烈反对，在遗嘱中赋予了自己的奴隶以自由。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: He asserted, also, that his power to follow a long and purely abstract
entries.text:
## 原句

He asserted, also, that his power to follow a long and purely abstract train of thought was very limited, for which reason he felt certain that he never could have succeeded with mathematics.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 定语从句 / 虚拟语气

## 生词

- assert/əˈsɜːrt/v.断言，宣称
- follow/ˈfɑːloʊ/v.（僻）跟上，理解（思路）；跟随
- abstract/ˈæbstrækt/adj.抽象的
- train/treɪn/n.（僻）一连串，一系列（a train of thought 思路）
- succeed/səkˈsiːd/v.成功；（僻）继承，继任

## 主干

主干为「He（主）+ asserted（谓）+ that 引导的宾语从句」，for which reason 引出由此产生的结论。

## 解析

- 本句主干：He asserted that...，that 引导宾语从句；also 为插入语，表明这是他所陈述的又一点。
- 宾语从句内主干为 his power was very limited；不定式短语 to follow a long and purely abstract train of thought 作后置定语修饰 power。
- for which reason he felt certain... 为「介词+which」引出的非限制性定语从句，which 指代前面整个主句内容，for which reason 相当于「因此」。
- that he never could have succeeded... 为 felt certain 之后的宾语从句；could have succeeded 是对过去的虚拟推断，意为「本来也绝不可能成功」。

## 翻译

他还断言，自己进行长时间纯抽象思考的能力十分有限，因此他确信自己当初在数学上是绝不可能取得成功的。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: This increasingly high level of education is probably a necessary, but
entries.text:
## 原句

This increasingly high level of education is probably a necessary, but not a sufficient, condition for the complex political systems required by advanced economic performance.

**标签**：插入语 / 并列结构 / 非谓语动词

## 生词

- increasingly/ɪnˈkriːsɪŋli/adv.日益，越来越
- sufficient/səˈfɪʃnt/adj.充分的，足够的
- condition/kənˈdɪʃn/n.条件；状况
- complex/kəmˈpleks/adj.复杂的
- advanced/ədˈvænst/adj.先进的，发达的
- performance/pərˈfɔːrməns/n.表现，绩效；性能

## 主干

主干为「This increasingly high level of education（主）+ is（系）+ a...condition（表）」，为主系表结构。

## 解析

- 本句主干：This...level of education is probably a...condition，说明教育水平与政治体制之间的条件关系。
- a necessary, but not a sufficient, condition 中 but not a sufficient 为插入成分，与 necessary 并列修饰 condition，意为「必要而非充分的」。
- for the complex political systems 为介词短语作后置定语，说明 condition 所针对的对象。
- required by advanced economic performance 为过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 systems，含被动意义「为发达经济表现所需要的」。

## 翻译

对于发达经济表现所需要的复杂政治体制而言，这种日益提高的教育水平很可能是一个必要但非充分的条件。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: It may be said that the measure of the worth of any social institution
entries.text:
## 原句

It may be said that the measure of the worth of any social institution is its effect in enlarging and improving experience, but this effect is not a part of its original motive.

**标签**：名词性从句 / 被动语态 / 并列结构

## 生词

- measure/ˈmeʒər/n.衡量标准，尺度；v. 测量
- worth/wɜːrθ/n.价值
- institution/ˌɪnstɪˈtuːʃn/n.机构；制度
- enlarge/ɪnˈlɑːrdʒ/v.扩大，扩展
- motive/ˈmoʊtɪv/n.动机，目的
- effect/ɪˈfekt/n.影响，作用；效果

## 主干

主干为 but 连接的并列句：分句一「It（形式主语）+ may be said + that 主语从句」，分句二「this effect（主）+ is not（系）+ a part（表）」。

## 解析

- 本句为 but 连接的并列句；前一分句中 It 为形式主语，真正主语是 that 引导的从句，may be said 为被动语态，意为「可以说」。
- 主语从句内主干为 the measure is its effect；of the worth of any social institution 为层层嵌套的介词短语作后置定语，修饰 measure。
- in enlarging and improving experience 中 in+动名词短语作后置定语修饰 effect，enlarging 与 improving 由 and 并列。
- 后一分句 this effect is not a part of its original motive 中，its 指代 social institution，of its original motive 修饰 part。

## 翻译

可以说，衡量任何社会机构价值的标准，是它在丰富和改善经验方面的作用，但这种作用并不是其最初动机的一部分。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: Only gradually was the by-product of the institution noted, and only m
entries.text:
## 原句

Only gradually was the by-product of the institution noted, and only more gradually still was this effect considered as a directive factor in the conduct of the institution.

**标签**：倒装 / 被动语态 / 并列结构

## 生词

- by-product/ˈbaɪˌprɑːdʌkt/n.副产品；附带结果
- note/noʊt/v.（僻）注意到，指出；n. 笔记
- still/stɪl/adv.（僻）还要，更（more gradually still 更慢）；仍然
- directive/dəˈrektɪv/adj.指导性的；n. 指令
- conduct/ˈkɑːndʌkt/n.（僻）管理，实施，进行；v. 引导，指挥

## 主干

主干为 and 连接的两个并列分句，均因 Only+状语置于句首而部分倒装：「was the by-product...noted」「was this effect considered...」。

## 解析

- 本句由 and 连接两个并列分句，均以 Only+状语开头，故谓语中的 be 动词 was 提到主语之前，构成部分倒装。
- 分句一还原为正常语序 the by-product of the institution was noted，was noted 为被动语态，of the institution 修饰 by-product。
- 分句二还原为 this effect was considered as a directive factor，only more gradually still 意为「还要更慢」。
- in the conduct of the institution 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 factor；conduct 为名词熟词僻义，意为「管理、运作」。

## 翻译

人们只是逐渐地才注意到这一机构所产生的副产品，而把这种作用视为机构运作中的指导性因素，则经历了一个更加缓慢的过程。

entries.text:
## 原句

If humanity has made some headway in realizing that the ultimate value of every institution is its distinctively human effect we may well believe that this lesson has been learned largely through dealings with the young. 百句实战后续复习安排（详见百句实战Day100）：

**标签**：状语从句 / 名词性从句 / 被动语态

## 生词

- humanity/hjuːˈmænəti/n.人类；人性
- headway/ˈhedweɪ/n.进步，进展（make headway 取得进展）
- ultimate/ˈʌltɪmət/adj.最终的，根本的
- distinctively/dɪˈstɪŋktɪvli/adv.独特地，特有地
- dealing/ˈdiːlɪŋ/n.交往，往来；对待
- well/wel/adv.（僻）（may well）很可能，完全有理由

## 主干

主干为「we（主）+ may well believe（谓）+ that 引导的宾语从句」，句首为 if 引导的条件状语从句。

## 解析

- 本句主干：we may well believe that...，may well 意为「完全有理由、很可能」，that 引导宾语从句。
- If humanity has made some headway in realizing that... 为 if 引导的条件状语从句；make headway 为固定搭配「取得进展」，in 后接动名词 realizing。
- realizing 之后的 that the ultimate value...is its distinctively human effect 为 that 引导的宾语从句，作 realizing 的宾语。
- 主句中 this lesson has been learned 为被动语态；through dealings with the young 为介词短语作状语，the young 指年轻人这一类人。注意条件从句与主句之间原文无逗号，需借谓语动词定位主句。

## 翻译

如果人类在认识到「每个机构的最终价值在于其独具人性的影响」方面取得了一些进展，那么我们完全有理由相信，这一认识主要是通过与年轻人的交往获得的。
